column12: THERAPEUTIC BIOMATERIAL THAT ATTENUATES THE FOREIGN BODY RESPONSE
column13: Systems and methods to eliminate or reduce the foreign body response (FBR) that occurs when a medical device is implanted into a patient. The FBR causes a chronic inflammatory response that leads to the encapsulation of a medical device by a fibrous capsule. Macrophages have been discovered to become persistent as a result of the implanted biomaterial which occurs by an up-regulation in cFLIP. This persistence of macrophages appears to be the primary driver of the FBR. Re-sensitizing macrophages to apoptosis using a small molecule inhibitor (e.g., YM155) of cFLIP will abrogate the formation of the fibrous capsule in the FBR.

column12: TUMOR-ASSOCIATED ANTIGENS IN BRAIN TUMORS
column13: The present invention relates to the identification and use of tumor epitopes from subjects with brain cancer, and particularly to epitopes from brevican, neurocan, versican, and aggrecan and their use in formulating cancer vaccines for treatment of tumor patients. In some preferred embodiments the methods provide a means of identifying T cell epitopes in proteins upregulated in brain tumors and the selection of those peptides which can stimulate T cell responses in individual subjects with a particular combination of HLA alleles. It further identifies the T cell exposed motifs comprised in T cell epitopes and enables the design of peptides with alternative amino acids in positions other than the T cell exposed motifs. In preferred embodiments, the MHC I and MHC II alleles of the affected subject are determined, and peptides are selected which bind to their MHC molecules with a desired affinity to elicit stimulation.

column12: LACRIMAL DRUG DELIVERY DEVICE
column13: A lacrimal drug delivery device includes a reservoir configured to hold a drug. The reservoir is moveable between a relaxed state and an expanded state. A connector is fluidly coupled to the reservoir and a lumen is formed in the connector wherein the drug is configured to flow from the reservoir to a delivery site through the lumen. A hydrogel is within the lumen and configured to absorb the drug from the reservoir and deliver the drug from the lumen at the delivery site. The hydrogel includes a first section which absorbs the drug at a first rate of absorption. A delivery guide is detachably coupled to the reservoir to deliver the reservoir into a lacrimal sac of a patient.

The hydrogel for exosome delivery prepared in the present invention integrates various functions, features good biocompatibility, injectability, self-healing, tissue adhesion, exosome binding and other properties, and is thus beneficial to maintaining the integrity of a hydrogel scaffold and the integration of the hydrogel and the host tissue. column12: NANO-COMPOSITE HYDROGEL FOR RADIOSENSITIZATION AFTER BREAST-CONSERVING SURGERY FOR BREAST CANCER AND PREPARATION METHOD THEREFOR
column13: A nano-composite hydrogel for radiosensitization after breast-conserving surgery for breast cancer and a preparation method therefor. The nano-composite hydrogel comprises a hydrogel loaded with mesoporus gold nanoparticles M@AuNPs. The preparation method is as follows: The starting materials include a modified chitosan solution, a modified hyaluronic acid solution, and M@AuNPs. M@AuNPs are dispersed in the modified hyaluronic acid solution and the modified chitosan solution is isovolumetrically mixed with the modified hyaluronic acid solution to give the hydrogel. An injectable hydrogel encapsulating nanoparticles. The injectable hydrogel has a structure uniformly encapsulating outer-layer modified gold nanoparticles, and is capable of implementing immunotherapy by means of the targeted sustained-release of therapeutic drugs and meanwhile achieving ray energy accumulation due to the higher atomic number of the gold nanoparticles, thereby effectively killing tumor cells at the tumor bed position. The strategy effectively reduces the radiation dose in the whole breast radiotherapy, and is beneficial to protecting normal tissues of the breast outside the tumor bed.

column12: Drug conjugated nanogels in microcapsule for delayed sustained protein delivery
column13: Injectable compositions and use of the injectable compositions in tissue engineering applications are described. The injectable compositions are hydrogel-based compositions that can be crosslinked in situ following placement. The injectable compositions include microcapsules having predetermined erosion profiles that are loaded with nanogels having predetermined sustained release profiles for signaling molecules conjugated to the nanogels. Following crosslinking, the compositions are designed to sequentially release signaling molecules over a predetermined period of time with various release profiles. The compositions can carry additional components to stimulate tissue generation such as stem cells and extracellular matrix (ECM) components.

column12: Epigallocatechin-3-gallate loaded guanosine borate hydrogel as well as preparation method and application thereof
column13: The invention relates to the field of biomedical materials, in particular to catechin loaded guanosine borate hydrogel as well as a preparation method and application thereof. The preparation method comprises the following steps: putting guanosine and KOH into a round-bottom flask, adding deionized water, heating and stirring until guanosine is completely dissolved; then adding boric acid and epigallocatechin-3-gallate (EGCG), continuously heating and stirring until the reaction is completed, and cooling to room temperature, so as to prepare the EGCG loaded guanosine borate hydrogel. According to the hydrogel disclosed by the invention, guanosine is self-assembled to form a G-quadrubplex network, and boric acid ester bonds are introduced to strengthen crosslinking, so that the stability and the mechanical strength of the gel are improved. PH/ROS dual response is achieved, and precise controlled release is achieved; the epigallocatechin-3-gallate is stably loaded, so that the stability of the epigallocatechin-3-gallate is improved, the bioavailability is increased, the biocompatibility is good, and the epigallocatechin-3-gallate is free from tissue toxicity; angiogenesis is promoted, and diabetes wound healing is accelerated.

column12: 3D printing silk fibroin-based temperature-sensitive hydrogel as well as preparation method and application thereof

column12: Ultraviolet polymerization hydrogel and preparation method thereof
column13: The invention relates to a method for preparing PyBN/PEGDA hydrogel through ultraviolet radiation and performance research of the PyBN/PEGDA hydrogel. According to the hydrogel, polyethylene glycol diacrylate (PEGDA) is used as a monomer, a novel water-soluble photoinitiator PyBN is used as an initiator, free radical crosslinking reaction is initiated through 365nm ultraviolet light irradiation, and the hydrogel with excellent mechanical property and controllable swelling behavior is formed. Experimental results show that compared with hydrogel prepared by a traditional photoinitiator 1173, the PyBN/PEGDA hydrogel has higher elasticity and strain capacity, is lower in cross-linked network density and can bear larger compression amount. Besides, the swelling ratio of the hydrogel in deionized water at 25 DEG C is only 110.9%, and the hydrogel shows good dimensional stability and swelling controllability and is suitable for the field of biological medicine. The hydrogel provided by the invention is simple in preparation method, PyBN is applied to hydrogel crosslinking for the first time as a pyrrolo-pyrrole structure photoinitiator, and a new idea is provided for developing a high-performance water-soluble photoinitiator and functional hydrogel. The hydrogel has wide application prospects in the fields of drug sustained release, cell culture, biosensors and the like.

column12: PROCESS FOR PREPARING LIPOSOME-ENCAPSULATED PEPTIDE P33
column13: A process enables efficient preparation of liposome-encapsulated peptide P33. The process comprising preparing a peptide P33; preparing a lipid mixture by dissolving 70-90 mg of phospholipid including granulated soy lecithin and 20 mg of cholesterol in 15-25 mg of a chloroform/methanol solvent system; evaporating organic solvent using a magnetic stirrer coupled with a heating system until a lipid film is fully formed and hydrated; removing solvent traces by drying the lipid film under vacuum conditions overnight; rehydrating the lipid film with 8-12 mL of a buffer containing 190-210 μg/mL of peptide P33; mixing the rehydrated lipid film thoroughly using a magnetic stirrer at ambient temperature to ensure uniform dispersion; sonicating the lipid suspension until a clear, translucent solution is obtained; and extruding the resulting suspension using a vortex to form large unilamellar vesicles (LUVs) with a uniform size of approximately 200 nm.

column12: Preparation and application of strong tissue adhesion multifunctional injectable hydrogel responding to wound microenvironment
column13: The invention provides a preparation method of strong tissue adhesion multifunctional injectable hydrogel responding to a wound microenvironment and application of the strong tissue adhesion multifunctional injectable hydrogel in the aspect of delivering antibacterial natural products. The injectable hydrogel capable of filling wounds in situ is prepared by mixing arginine modified gelatin with antibacterial and tissue repair promoting functions with dopamine modified carboxymethyl chitosan which provides hemostasis and strong tissue adhesion by adopting an enzymatic and ionic crosslinking strategy and carrying out Schiff base reaction on arginine amino groups and a carboxymethyl chitosan carboxylic acid structure. The prepared hydrogel has dynamic reversibility, can be reconstructed after being broken by external force, and can precisely and controllably release a bacteriostatic natural product according to the pH change of a wound microenvironment. The hydrogel is good in biocompatibility, simple in preparation process, green and low in cost, and has a wide application prospect in wound infection treatment, especially in the field of delivery of antibacterial natural products.

column12: Injectable shear-thinning hydrogel containing therapeutic agent for enhanced tumor therapy
column13: We have developed novel shear-thinning biomaterials using silica nanoparticles, gelatin-based polymers and small molecules such as doxorubicin. Shear-thinning biomaterial technology offers enables polymers and drugs loaded inside such polymers to be easily delivered directly through catheters into target area for use, for example, in cancer therapy and immunotherapy. When a force above a certain threshold is applied to inject such materials, they “thin” and behaves as a semi-solid, allowing the material to readily flow through a catheter. When the force is removed, the material instantly becomes a soft solid with significant cohesive properties that prevent it from dislodging or breaking up.

column12: Injectable self-healing nano composite hydrogel as well as preparation method and application thereof
column13: The invention provides an injectable self-healing nano composite hydrogel system, a preparation method and application, and belongs to the technical field of biomedical materials.The injectable self-healing nano composite hydrogel system is prepared with PLGA as a raw material to serve as an inner core and encapsulate quercetin, quercetin nanoparticles are formed, bionic fusion is achieved through the quercetin nanoparticles and a neutrophile granulocyte membrane activated on the outer layer through a probe ultrasonic technology, and the injectable self-healing nano composite hydrogel system is obtained. The preparation method comprises the following steps: preparing an activated neutrophile granulocyte membrane-coated bionic nano drug delivery system by taking propargyl cysteine as a template, preparing injectable hydrogel by taking hyaluronic acid and oxidized hyaluronic acid as raw materials, modifying propargyl cysteine by the oxidized hyaluronic acid through a Schiff base bond to prepare pH response hydrogel, and then combining the injectable hydrogel with the bionic nano drug delivery system, so as to prepare the drug delivery system for the neutrophile granulocyte membrane-coated bionic nano drug delivery system. Finally, the nano composite hydrogel system which is injectable, self-healing, pH-responsive and capable of realizing intelligent drug delivery is constructed. In-vivo and in-vitro experiments show that the hydrogel delivery system has the effects of resisting inflammation, resisting oxidation, regulating immunity, promoting angiogenesis and accelerating tissue regeneration, and can effectively promote the repair of diabetic wounds.

column12: PLGA-minoxidil microneedle with near-infrared response and preparation method of PLGA-minoxidil microneedle
column13: The invention discloses a PLGA (poly (lactic-co-glycolic acid))-minoxidil microneedle with near-infrared response and a preparation method of the PLGA-minoxidil microneedle. The PLGA-minoxidil microspheres are combined with the hydrogel microneedle with near-infrared response, controlled release of MXD is achieved on the microstructure through cooperation of the microporous structure of the microspheres and the near-infrared response effect of lanthanum hexaboride nanoparticles, the side effect of the medicine is effectively reduced, the concentration of the medicine in the body can be better maintained, and the drug delivery effect is improved. A better treatment effect is achieved; macroscopically, the prepared hydrogel system has relatively good mechanical properties, and can provide a stable drug delivery channel and drug delivery efficiency.

column12: Chitosan photosensitive hydrogel, drug-loaded photosensitive hydrogel as well as preparation method and application of chitosan photosensitive hydrogel and drug-loaded photosensitive hydrogel
column13: The invention belongs to the technical field of gel preparations, and particularly relates to a chitosan photosensitive hydrogel, a drug-loaded photosensitive hydrogel and a preparation method and application of the chitosan photosensitive hydrogel and the drug-loaded photosensitive hydrogel. The invention provides a chitosan photosensitive hydrogel. The chitosan photosensitive hydrogel comprises a chitosan-photosensitizer cross-linked substance and water, the photosensitizer is a tetra-p-phenylamino porphyrin compound. According to the chitosan photosensitive hydrogel provided by the invention, chitosan is used as a hydrogel framework material, a tetra-p-phenylamino porphyrin compound is used as a photosensitizer, a novel photodynamic hydrogel network is constructed, and the obtained chitosan photosensitive hydrogel takes elasticity as a leading material, has relatively good temperature sensitivity and light sensitivity, and can be used for preparing a photodynamic hydrogel. The compound can be used as a chemotherapy drug carrier, realizes combined treatment of a photodynamic therapy and a chemotherapy, realizes an efficient combined anticancer effect, improves a curative effect, reduces toxicity, and provides a new idea for construction and application of a photodynamic-chemotherapy anticancer drug system.

column12: Compressed Collagen Composite Construct for Cell or Therapeutic Delivery
column13: Technology is provided for the production of collagen-based composite grafts with robust mechanical properties exceeding that of typical collagen hydrogels or foams. Collagen is a biodegradable and biocompatible hydrogel, but its clinical application is limited by poor mechanical properties that hinders its manipulation during surgeries and its post-surgical stability. Cells from various sources, bone marrow aspirate concentrates, growth factors, nanoparticles/microparticles (NPs/MPs), and supportive polymer meshes can be incorporated into the membranes for drug delivery and tissue regenerative therapies.

column12: Photo-coupled synergistically crosslinked hydrogel material and its composition, preparation method, use, product, and preparation kit
column13: This invention provides a preparation, composition, product, and application of a photo-coupled synergistically crosslinked hydrogel material. The preparation includes dissolving Component A including a photosensitive polymer derivative having o-nitrobenzyl phototriggers and Component B including a polymer derivative having amine or alkene (double group) or sulfhydryl group in a biocompatible medium to obtain solution A and solution B, respectively; mixing the solution A and solution B homogeneously to obtain a hydrogel precursor solution; initiating photo-coupled synergistic crosslinking under an irradiation of a UV light to form the hydrogel. The irradiation causes the o-nitrobenzyl phototriggers to generate an aldehyde group/keto group or a nitroso group to initiate photo-coupled synergetic crosslinking. The photo-coupled synergistically crosslinked hydrogel has applications in tissue engineering, regenerative medicine, 3D printing and as a carrier of cell, protein or drug.

column12: Ossification center organoid and preparation method and application thereof

column12: Pathogenic affinity pathway of infectious or parasitic organisms for nanogram and picogram dosimetry prophylaxis or cure
column13: The sustenance of life is driven by recognition of and access to energy sources. This process has remained unchanged over billions of years, guiding cellular nutrition through molecular recognition, akin to the food pyramid. At the atomic or nanoscale, chemotaxis enables organisms to identify ingestible matter and is driven by their need for fuel, rather than from the sustenance itself. Chemotaxis, one of nature's most potent yet invisible organic forces, operates independently of molecular charge dynamics to locate and identify microscopic sustenance. Infectious organisms, such as pathogenic microbes and parasites, depend on chemotactic pathways to locate nutrition across all scales. This invention leverages this phenomenon by “baiting” these pathways with nutritive matter that encapsulates biocidal agents that are harmless to humans but lethal to infectious organisms once ingested. These nutritive biocidal agents could be employed as topical, oral, injectable, or aerosolized formulations, as well as hydrogel or slow-release implants.

The hydrogel has excellent gel properties such as injectability, heat sensitivity and stability, and can be used as an ideal drug delivery system to be applied to treatment of low-immunogenicity tumors such as advanced malignant liver cancer ascites and melanoma. The hydrogel has the effects of inducing apoptosis and ferroptosis of tumor cells and reprogramming an immunosuppressive tumor microenvironment. The tumor inhibition rate reaches 82% when the compound is combined with alpha-PD-L1 immunotherapy checkpoint blocking treatment in a liver cancer malignant ascites mouse model, and the tumor inhibition rate reaches 98% when the compound is combined with adoptive cell therapy in a melanoma mouse model. In addition, the hydrogel has good biocompatibility, and is a novel anti-tumor hydrogel which is simple to prepare, green and has clinical transformation potential.

column12: Exploiting oxygen inhibited photopolymerization within emulsion droplets for the fabrication of microparticles with customizable size, shape and interfacial and mechanical properties
column13: Described are methods and devices for the generation of hydrogel particles with micrometer and submicrometer dimensions using oxygen-inhibited partial polymerization, and the particles generated therefrom. The described methods generate particles with dimensions independent of the starting polymerizable solution dimension, for example, a microdroplet. Further, microfluidic flow parameters (e.g. viscosity, flow rate) and photopolymerization process parameters (e.g. optical exposure intensity and duration) are controlled to generate particles with tunable crosslinking density-determined properties including elasticity, diffusivity, and biomolecular display for diverse applications such as drug delivery, tissue engineering cell scaffolds, and single- and multiple-cell therapeutics. Similarly, gradients of crosslinking density-determined properties can be created within single particles through the selection of optical exposure intensity and duration. In addition to conventional spherical shapes, a suite of non-spherical shapes may be generated by manipulating the dimensions of the microfluidic channels and other related physical and process parameters.

column12: Photo-thermal response type insect sex pheromone sustained release preparation and application thereof
column13: The invention discloses a photo-thermal response type insect sex pheromone sustained release preparation and application. The preparation is prepared from 54.55 wt% to 59.41 wt% of thermal response hydrogel, 0.99 wt% to 9.09 wt% of copper-polyphenol nano particles and 36.36 wt% to 39.6 wt% of insect sex pheromone emulsion. Mixing the insect sex pheromone emulsion, the copper-phenol nanoparticles and the thermal response hydrogel, fully stirring for 30 minutes to ensure that the insect sex pheromone is uniformly distributed in the thermal response hydrogel solution, and cooling at the temperature of 30 DEG C or below to prepare hydrogel, so as to obtain the photo-thermal response type insect sex pheromone sustained release preparation. The release rate of the insect sex pheromone is cooperatively controlled through the photothermal conversion effect of the copper-polyphenol nanoparticles and the temperature response of the thermal response hydrogel. The release speed of the insect sex pheromone can be controlled by controlling different illumination intensities, illumination time and temperature conditions, and the lasting period of the insect sex pheromone is remarkably prolonged.

column12: Temperature response type cycloxaprid controlled release system and preparation method thereof
column13: The invention provides a temperature response type cycloxaprid controlled release system and a preparation method thereof, and belongs to the technical field of alkali insecticides. The temperature response type cycloxaprid controlled release system provided by the invention comprises a poly (N-isopropylacrylamide) temperature-sensitive hydrogel and a polyurethane-cycloxaprid oil-in-water microcapsule, wherein the poly (N-isopropylacrylamide) hydrogel and the polyurethane-cycloxaprid oil-in-water microcapsule form a semi-interpenetrating network structure. According to the invention, polyurethane and poly (N-isopropylacrylamide) temperature-sensitive (PNIPAAm) hydrogel are utilized to form a semi-interpenetrating network structure, so that the low critical transition temperature of a controlled release system is reduced, and the controlled release system has good thermal stability and temperature-sensitive characteristics. According to data of an embodiment, the temperature response type cycloxaprid controlled release system obtained by the invention has good drug release performance and good stability in an environment of 20-31 DEG C.

column12: Iontophoresis dosing device
column13: The invention belongs to the technical field of medical auxiliary instruments, and relates to an iontophoresis dosing device which comprises a ring body, the ring body comprises a first shell, a second shell and two connecting pieces of the same structure, and the two connecting pieces are located on the two sides of the first shell correspondingly to achieve connection of the first shell and the second shell; the first treatment assembly comprises a first hydrogel patch, a second hydrogel patch and a constant current source circuit system, the first hydrogel patch is arranged on the concave surface of the first shell, the second hydrogel patch is arranged on the concave surface of the second shell, and the constant current source circuit system is arranged on the second shell and electrically connected with the first hydrogel patch and the second hydrogel patch; an electric field perpendicular to eyes is formed, so that gaps of cornea and sclera are changed to form a water channel with a fixed direction, and medicine enters the deep positions of the eyes along the water channel. The device is small in size, convenient to operate, capable of being used at home and low in economic cost, and the transdermal drug delivery efficiency and stability are improved.

column12: Preparation method of liposome/cellulose hydrogel loaded with large amount of water-soluble drospirenone
column13: The invention discloses a preparation method of liposome/cellulose hydrogel carrying a large amount of water-soluble drospirenone, and belongs to the field of drospirenone solubilization and slow release application. The method comprises the following steps: 1, preparing drospirenone liposome by adopting an ethanol injection method: weighing soybean lecithin, drospirenone and cholesterol, adding an absolute ethanol solution, dissolving in a water bath at 30 DEG C to form an oil phase, injecting the oil phase into PBS (Phosphate Buffer Solution), and stirring in a water bath; 2, hydroxyethyl cellulose is dissolved in distilled water, a NaOH solution and C3H5ClO are added, sealing and stirring are conducted, and standing and crosslinking are conducted; and washing the sample to remove excessive alkali and cross-linking agent. And freeze-drying to obtain dry hydrogel, putting the dry hydrogel into the liposome supernatant, and completely absorbing to obtain the drospirenone liposome hydrogel. The problem of poor water solubility of drospirenone is solved by adopting a liposome solubilization method, and the problem of poor stability of high-drug-loading drospirenone/liposome is solved through hydrogel immobilization. After the preparation process is optimized, the maximum encapsulation efficiency of the drospirenone liposome reaches 80-85%, and the drug delivery system can realize long-acting release.

column13: The invention belongs to the technical field of biological materials, and particularly relates to an injectable insulin hydrogel with glucose responsiveness and a preparation method and application thereof. The invention develops an injectable hydrogel which has glucose responsiveness and is easy to degrade, and the injectable hydrogel is used for precisely controlled release of insulin. The hydrogel is prepared by combining silk fibroin and phenylboronic acid, based on the self-adjusting response of phenylboronic acid to glucose, the hydrogel shows specific response to the concentration of glucose in blood, and long-acting release can be achieved. Moreover, the hydrogel can be completely metabolized in vivo within a short time, has no adverse reaction in animal experiments, and shows good in-vivo applicability. Besides, the silk fibroin-phenylboronic acid-based hydrogel is simple to prepare and low in production cost, and a new method is provided for developing long-acting intelligent insulin preparations and using injectable hydrogel for glucose metabolism or/and clinical treatment of insulin dysfunction diseases.

column12: Rapid photo-crosslinking drug sustained release type multifunctional hydrogel corneal contact lens and preparation method thereof
column13: The invention discloses a rapid photo-crosslinking drug sustained release type multifunctional hydrogel corneal contact lens and a preparation method thereof. The preparation method comprises the following steps: (1) preparing quaternized chitosan, an acrylate monomer, methacrylic acid, a crosslinking agent and an initiator into a reaction mixed solution according to a ratio; (2) transferring the reaction mixed solution into a mold, carrying out an ultraviolet irradiation free radical polymerization reaction, after the reaction is finished, demolding, taking out hydrogel, washing, and carrying out freeze drying treatment to obtain freeze-dried hydrogel; and (3) immersing the freeze-dried hydrogel into a drug monomer solution until the hydrogel is completely swelled. The corneal contact lens prepared by the method disclosed by the invention can be polymerized in one step and rapidly prepared, has proper water content of a finished product, has excellent light transmission and mechanical properties, can effectively load traditional Chinese medicine antibacterial drugs and prolong the release time of the drugs, has a remarkable curative effect in treatment of bacterial keratitis, and is suitable for popularization and application. As a therapeutic corneal contact lens, the corneal contact lens has a wide market application prospect.

column12: Absorbable bone wax as well as preparation method and application thereof
column13: The invention discloses absorbable bone wax as well as a preparation method and application thereof. The preparation method of the absorbable bone wax comprises the following steps: 1) mixing nano black phosphorus with a Tris-HCl solution of polydopamine, and reacting to obtain polydopamine modified nano black phosphorus; 2) in an ice bath environment, dropwise adding a sodium beta-glycerophosphate pentahydrate solution into the chitosan solution to obtain chitosan hydrogel; 3) under an ice bath condition, blending the nano black phosphorus modified by the polydopamine with the chitosan hydrogel to obtain a blended solution; and (4) blending a medicine for promoting fracture healing into the blended solution to obtain the absorbable bone wax. The bone wax disclosed by the invention has the characteristics of super adhesion, temperature sensitivity, intelligent drug release control and rapid hemostasis, for example, in-vitro intelligent controlled release of a drug loaded on the bone wax disclosed by the invention can be realized by utilizing 808nm near-infrared light irradiation time.

column12: SUSTAINED-RELEASE GEL WITH INSOLUBLE SALT AS PH ADJUSTER, PREPARATION METHOD AND APPLICATION THEREOF
column13: A sustained-release gel with insoluble salt as pH adjuster, and its preparation method and application are disclosed. The sustained-release gel is obtained by dissolving polymer in an aqueous solvent, followed by blending and compounding the alkaline inclusion and the insoluble salt crystalline powder. The insoluble salt is at solid state and thus has thus a large amount as the reservoir of the pH adjuster. The preparation is injectable, can be converted into gel state after being injected into organism, and realizes the sustained release of the inclusion at the injection site. The presence of the insoluble salt reduces the solubility of the inclusion in the gel by releasing the free salt sustainably and thus adjusting the pH inside the gel in a sustained manner. The burst release of the inclusion out of the gel is significantly alleviated.

column12: Acellular amnion matrix hydrogel and preparation method thereof
column13: The invention provides a decellularized amnion matrix hydrogel and a preparation method thereof. The preparation method comprises the following steps: amnion tissue pretreatment, cleaning, decellularization, grinding, freeze-drying, digestion and acid-base neutralization. According to the decellularized amnion matrix hydrogel, active cells are removed while collagen, fibronectin, glycoprotein and other components in an amnion cell matrix are reserved, and the immunogenicity of the decellularized amnion matrix hydrogel is reduced from the source. The decellularized amniotic membrane matrix hydrogel provided by the invention can simulate the microenvironment of in-vivo cells, provides support and signals required by cell adhesion and growth, can be used for constructing a tissue engineering scaffold, and provides support for directional growth and tissue regeneration of cells. Besides, the decellularized amniotic membrane matrix hydrogel can also be used as a drug carrier for in-vivo drug release and treatment, and has very high application potential in medical research and clinical application.

column12: Method for preparing carboxymethylated xanthan gum-sulfated xanthan gum-methacrylated gelatin hydrogel scaffold
column13: The invention discloses a method for preparing a carboxymethylated xanthan gum-sulfated xanthan gum-methacrylated gelatin hydrogel scaffold, and belongs to the technical field of natural high polymer materials. The preparation method comprises the following steps: respectively reacting xanthan gum with chloroacetic acid and chlorosulfonic acid, purifying to obtain carboxymethylated xanthan gum and sulfated xanthan gum, reacting gelatin with methacrylic anhydride, purifying to obtain methylacryloylated gelatin, and drying to obtain the methylacryloylated gelatin. And dissolving the obtained carboxymethylated xanthan gum, sulfated xanthan gum and methacrylated gelatin in deionized water, and carrying out optical radiation crosslinking for 10-600 seconds by using a 0.05 wt%-1 wt% phenyl-2, 4, 6-trimethylbenzoyl lithium phosphinate aqueous solution photoinitiator, so as to obtain the carboxymethylated xanthan gum-sulfated xanthan gum-methacrylated gelatin hydrogel scaffold. The used raw materials are rich in source, the used photoinitiator is low in toxicity, good in water solubility and efficient, and the prepared stent material can be biomimetic mineralized, can controllably release embedded drugs, and is good in mechanical property and good in biocompatibility. The carboxymethylated xanthan gum-sulfated xanthan gum-methacrylated gelatin hydrogel can be used for preparing bone tissue repair materials, 3D printing artificial tissue scaffolds, biomedical materials and drug controlled release carriers.

column12: Melphalan gel based on ultrasonic response as well as preparation method and application of melphalan gel

Melphalan hydrogels can be used to improve traditional HAIC treatment methods for liver cancer, including expediting catheter removal, reducing systemic toxicity, increasing local drug concentration, and prolonging drug-cell interaction time. In a rat model, the Melphalan hydrogel-assisted HAIC shows better effectiveness than the traditional HAIC, can significantly inhibit the growth of liver cancer, activates effective anti-tumor immune response, and realizes complete cure in part of liver cancer. In addition, the drug delivery capability of the melphalan hydrogel is expected to improve the pharmacokinetic characteristics of various drugs and promote the synergistic treatment effect of various drugs. column13: A cationic contact lens is described as well as methods of manufacturing the same. column12: Formula optimization and preparation method of composite gel for sodium fluoride drug sustained release
column13: The invention provides a formula optimization and preparation method of a composite gel for sodium fluoride drug sustained release, and belongs to the technical field of composite gels for sodium fluoride drug sustained release, and the formula optimization method comprises the following steps: designing a plurality of groups of initial formulas based on literatures and preparatory experiments, the influence of the graphene oxide, the monomer, the cross-linking agent and other components on the slow-release gel performance is emphatically investigated. Main formula parameters are determined through a principal component analysis method, and a second-order polynomial model is established to optimize performance indexes. A deep neural network model is adopted to perform virtual screening in a wider parameter space, and candidate formulas are selected in combination with an analytic hierarchy process and a TOPSIS method. The preparation method comprises the following steps: uniformly dispersing graphene oxide in deionized water, adding acrylic acid and acrylamide monomers, performing ultrasonic dispersion, degassing, adding a cross-linking agent and an initiator, heating in a water bath to obtain polyacrylamide composite hydrogel, and soaking the polyacrylamide composite hydrogel in a sodium fluoride solution to obtain the composite hydrogel loaded with the sodium fluoride medicine.

column12: Adhesive hydrogel drug-loaded microsphere for acupoint stimulation, and preparation method and application thereof
column13: The invention provides an adhesive hydrogel drug-loaded microsphere for acupoint stimulation as well as a preparation method and application thereof, and relates to the technical field of medicines. Comprising the following steps: S1, weighing phosphatidylserine and cholesterol powder, dissolving the phosphatidylserine and cholesterol powder in trichloromethane, and performing rotary evaporation to remove a solvent until the phosphatidylserine and cholesterol powder is dried to form a lipid film; s2, pouring a PBS (Phosphate Buffer Solution) added with adenosine into the lipid film, and hydrating to form a liposome solution; s3, preparing mineral oil and a Ge MA solution, uniformly mixing the liposome solution with the Ge MA solution, and adding a photoinitiator to obtain a mixed solution; s4, the mixed solution is subjected to a photo-crosslinking reaction under the condition of ultraviolet lamp irradiation, and hydrogel drug-loaded microspheres are formed; and S5, adding the hydrogel drug-loaded microspheres into a dopamine solution, and forming a polydopamine coating on the surfaces of the microspheres. According to the invention, the free adenosine is embedded in the hydrogel microspheres with adhesion to acupuncture points, so that the sustained release of the adenosine can be realized, the problem of short half-life period of the adenosine can be overcome, and the lasting time of the drug effect can be prolonged.

column12: Nanolipogel vehicles for controlled delivery of different pharmaceutical agents
column13: A “nanolipogel” is a delivery vehicle including one or more lipid layer surrounding a hydrogel core, which may include an absorbent such as a cyclodextrin or ion-exchange resin. Nanolipogels can be constructed so as to incorporate a variety of different chemical entities that can subsequently be released in a controlled fashion. These different incorporated chemical entities can differ dramatically with respect to size and composition. Nanolipogels have been constructed to contain co-encapsulated proteins as well as small hydrophobic drugs within the interior of the lipid bilayer. Agents incorporated within nanolipogels can be released into the milieu in a controlled fashion, for example, nanolipogels provide a means of achieving simultaneous sustained release of agents that differ widely in chemical composition and molecular weight. Additionally, nanolipogels can favorably modulate biodistribution.

column12: Preparation method and application of hydrogel microneedle and medicine storage cavern for treating nausea and vomiting
column13: The invention relates to a preparation method and application of a hydrogel microneedle and drug reservoir for treating nausea and vomiting, and can effectively solve the problem that oral administration of tumor patients for nausea and vomiting is inconvenient, and the technical scheme for solving the problem is as follows: 1) preparing a PDMS microneedle female template; 2) preparing a hydrogel microneedle material solution with the mass fraction of 40%; 3) preparing a hydrogel microneedle solution; 4) preparing a blank hydrogel microneedle; 5) preparing the fosaprepitant dimeglumine freeze-dried storage cavern, the prepared fosaprepitant dimeglumine freeze-dried storage cavern can be effectively used for preventing and treating the nausea and vomiting symptoms of cancer patients, the anti-vomiting drug fosaprepitant dimeglumine is applied to a microneedle drug delivery system for the first time, drug delivery for the nausea and vomiting patients is more convenient, the compliance is higher, and the freeze-dried storage cavern can be used for preventing and treating the nausea and vomiting symptoms. The micro-needle drug delivery system is an innovation of a micro-needle drug delivery system.

column12: Intelligent glucose response type micro needle tube as well as preparation method and application thereof
column13: The invention discloses an intelligent glucose response type micro needle tube as well as a preparation method and application thereof. Which comprises a needle body shell with a cavity structure and a medicine wrapped in the cavity structure, and is characterized in that dextran and sodium periodate are combined to prepare oxidized dextran, dopamine hydrochloride is added to prepare oxidized dextran grafted with dopamine, phenylboronic acid group compounds and ethylene glycol chitosan are prepared into phenylboronic acid grafted ethylene glycol chitosan, and the medicine is added into the oxidized dextran grafted with the dopamine to prepare the modified dextran grafted with the phenylboronic acid group compounds to prepare the modified dextran grafted with the phenylboronic acid group compounds and the modified dextran grafted with the phenylboronic acid group compounds. And mixing the two intermediate products to prepare cross-linked hydrogel, injecting the cross-linked hydrogel into a microneedle mold, adding a medicine, and drying to prepare the product. By constructing the intelligent glucose response type cavity needle body of a double-crosslinking gel network base, blood glucose concentration dependent type insulin intelligent release is achieved, drug loading cavity structures with different sizes are customized, the drug loading capacity and controllable insulin release performance and biocompatibility are improved, and the drug delivery efficiency is improved. And the safety and intelligence of micro-needle injection are improved.

column12: Intelligent response type chitosan gel system and preparation method thereof
column13: The invention relates to intelligent response type chitosan gel and a preparation method thereof. The intelligent response type chitosan gel is prepared from active oxygen response type lipidosome, a chitosan solution, a sodium glycerophosphate solution, a medicine and the like. According to the invention, a drug-loaded liposome with active oxygen response is introduced, and a nanoliposome with negative electricity is loaded into chitosan-sodium glycerophosphate gel in a charge adsorption manner, so that a response type multifunctional composite hydrogel system is prepared. After the intelligent response drug-loaded hydrogel system is injected into a human body, gel is formed in situ, the lubricating capacity of the hydrogel system is enhanced through introduction of lipidosome, and friction force in an articular cavity is reduced. Meanwhile, the liposome can be split through the process of removing active oxygen, and the medicine is controlled in the articular cavity in a controlled release manner. Therefore, the intelligent gel can delay the progress of arthritis through the synergistic effect of lubrication, oxidation resistance and inflammation resistance.

column12: Controllable drug sustained-release hydrogel as well as preparation method and application thereof
column13: The invention discloses controllable drug sustained-release hydrogel as well as a preparation method and application thereof, and belongs to the technical field of biomedical materials. Comprising the following steps: dissolving sodium alginate in deionized water to prepare a sodium alginate solution; stirring and mixing a hydrophobic drug and the sodium alginate solution to prepare a drug-loaded sodium alginate solution; stirring and mixing N, N-methylene bisacrylamide, sodium methacrylate and the sodium alginate solution loaded with the medicine to obtain a mixed solution; and uniformly mixing the mixed solution with an initiator, and polymerizing under the action of the initiator to obtain the controllable drug sustained-release hydrogel. The preparation process is simple, green and pollution-free, the hydrogel is used as a drug sustained-release material, the drug release rate is stable, the release efficiency is complete, the release period can be regulated and controlled, the sustained-release application requirements of different drugs can be completely met, and the hydrogel has wide application prospects in the fields of biomedical drug carriers and sustained-release materials.

column12: SYNTHESIS OF HYDROGELS BASED ON POLY (METHACRYL ACID) USING AN ENVIRONMENTAL FRIENDLY INITIATOR BASED ON HYDROGEN PEROXIDE, PEROXIDASE ISOLATED FROM WASTE MATERIAL AND VITAMIN C
column13: Invention relates hydrogels based on poly(methacrylic acid) that are obtained by a simple procedure that is financially profitable and in accordance with the principles of the circular economy. Also, with the present invention, it was achieved that these hydrogels can be obtained using an initiator based on a small amount of hydrogen peroxide, peroxidase isolated from potato peel or soybean flakes and vitamin C and that the synthesis is carried out at room temperature in the presence of oxygen. The present invention ensures that hydrogels based on poly(methacrylic acid) obtained by this method have optimal properties. Also obtained hydrogels based on poly(methacrylic acid) can be used for targeted delivery, prolonged and controlled release of anti-inflammatory drugs.

column12: Preparation method of exosome hydrogel loaded with miR-144-3p

column12: ROS-driven hemispherical hydrogel micromotor and preparation method and application thereof
column13: The invention discloses an ROS-driven hemispherical hydrogel micromotor and a preparation method and application thereof. column12: Broad-spectrum antibacterial and anti-inflammatory ultrasonic induced drug controlled release hydrogel
column13: The invention provides a broad-spectrum antibacterial and anti-inflammatory ultrasonic induced drug controlled release hydrogel. The release of anti-inflammatory and antibacterial drugs is controlled and regulated by utilizing an ultrasonic stimulation response mechanism. The preparation method comprises the following steps: synthesizing mesoporous barium titanate (MBTO) through a sol-gel method, functionalizing the mesoporous barium titanate (MBTO) through (3-mercaptopropyl) trimethoxysilane (MPTMS), and loading N-acetylcysteine (NAC) to prepare the BTO-NAC nanoparticles. And uniformly dispersing the particles in a cationic guar gum aqueous solution, and adding phytic acid and a proper amount of NaOH to form the BNGS hydrogel. In-vitro experiments show that BNGS has good cytocompatibility and a remarkable antibacterial effect, can respond to ultrasonic stimulation, accurately controls release of NAC, and effectively promotes transformation of macrophages to anti-inflammatory phenotypes. The broad-spectrum antibacterial and anti-inflammatory ultrasonic induced drug controlled release hydrogel BNGS has excellent self-healing performance and biological safety.

column12: Interleukin 12 hydrogel drug delivery system and preparation method thereof
column13: The invention relates to the technical field of biological medicines, and particularly discloses an interleukin 12 hydrogel drug delivery system and a preparation method thereof. The preparation method of the interleukin 12 hydrogel drug delivery system comprises the following steps: taking sodium alginate-RGD, and adding the sodium alginate-RGD into a DEME culture medium to obtain a sodium alginate-RGD mixed solution; the preparation method comprises the following steps: taking hectorite, adding hectorite into an IL-12 solution, uniformly mixing, standing at 0-5 DEG C for 20-40 minutes, and centrifuging to remove supernate, so as to obtain IL-12-loaded hectorite; uniformly mixing the hectorite loaded with the IL-12 with a sodium alginate-RGD (arginine-glycine-aspartic acid) mixed solution to obtain a hydrogel precursor solution; and uniformly mixing the hydrogel precursor solution with the calcium sulfate suspension, and standing for 30-60 minutes to obtain the interleukin 12 hydrogel drug delivery system. Researches show that the interleukin 12 hydrogel drug loading system prepared by the method disclosed by the invention has relatively high drug loading capacity on interleukin 12. In addition, the preparation method of the interleukin 12 hydrogel drug delivery system does not need special equipment, and is simple to operate, high in controllability and suitable for large-scale production.

column12: Gelatin-based bioactive supramolecular hybrid nano composite hydrogel and preparation method thereof
column13: The invention belongs to the field of biomedical hydrogel, and discloses gelatin-based bioactive supramolecular hybrid nano composite hydrogel and a preparation method thereof. The supramolecular hybrid nano composite hydrogel is stable under physiological conditions, and due to the introduction of the polydopamine functionalized nano clay, the supramolecular hybrid nano composite hydrogel can be endowed with osteogenic induction activity, hemostatic activity, antioxidant activity, photo-thermal response and other biological activities. The prepared supramolecular hybrid nano composite hydrogel has the advantages of stability, thixotropy, biological activity and the like under physiological conditions, and can be used in the fields of tissue engineering, drug delivery, tumor immunotherapy and the like.

column13: The invention discloses an anti-tumor intelligent hydrogel drug delivery system based on graphite oxide diyne and a preparation method and application of the anti-tumor intelligent hydrogel drug delivery system based on graphite oxide diyne. The system is composed of a polydimethyldiguanide hydrogel carrier and a graphite oxide diyne nano-composite in the carrier, the surface of the graphite oxide diyne nano-sheet is loaded with a chemotherapeutic drug which has two immunoregulation effects of down-regulating PD-L1 and promoting polarization of tumor-associated macrophages to M1 type, so that the graphite oxide diyne nano-composite is formed. column12: Preparation method and application of mechanical response bFGF (basic fibroblast growth factor) controlled-release hydrogel

column12: Breast prosthesis with breast cancer recurrence prevention and treatment and breast reconstruction functions and manufacturing method thereof
column13: The invention discloses a breast prosthesis with breast cancer recurrence prevention and treatment and breast reconstruction functions and a manufacturing method, the breast prosthesis is of a hemispheroid structure composed of a bottom plate and a support, a cylinder is arranged between the top of the support and the bottom plate, and the bottom plate and the support are provided with a plurality of holes to form a hollow hole-shaped structure; and the hollow structure is filled with fat or growth factor substances or drug-loaded hydrogel capable of specifically responding to tumors. The method has the beneficial effects that the tumor specific response function is combined with the prosthesis, and the breast prosthesis can be endowed with pore and channel structures by the 3D printing technology, so that the breast prosthesis has surplus space for loading the therapeutic hydrogel capable of specifically responding to the tumor. The ROS responsive hydrogel is used as a drug carrier to inhibit the occurrence and progression of tumors, and the hydrogel can specifically deliver a drug to a tumor site and reduce the level of ROS in TME. Therefore, the combination of the drug-loaded ROS responsive hydrogel and the 3D printed breast prosthesis is a good scheme for solving the problems of tumor treatment and beauty.

column12: Preparation and application of photosensitizer-liposome-hydrogel transdermal drug delivery system capable of being used for anti-tumor phototherapy
column13: The invention relates to the technical field of research and development of tumor photodynamic therapy photosensitizers and pharmaceutical preparations, in particular to a preparation method of a ruthenium complex photosensitizer and a preparation method and application of a liposome hydrogel transdermal drug delivery system with the photosensitizer as a main drug. The invention designs and invents a photosensitizer-liposome-hydrogel transdermal drug delivery system capable of being used for anti-tumor light therapy. The system not only has extremely high stability and two-photon absorption characteristic, but also can generate excellent singlet oxygen, biotoxicity and photothermal conversion capability under the action of infrared exciting light, so that the efficiency of killing cancer cells is improved, and the growth of melanoma in a mouse body is effectively inhibited. In addition, the drug delivery system creatively acts on the local area of the body through a transdermal drug delivery way, the side effect of blood drug delivery is relieved while the drug delivery difficulty is reduced, and the drug delivery system has the advantages of being painless, minimally invasive, efficient in drug delivery and the like and has wide application prospects in photodynamic therapy and photothermal therapy of tumors.

column12: GEL MATERIAL, PREPARATION METHOD THEREFOR, AND USE THEREOF
column13: A gel material, a preparation method therefor, and a use thereof. The gel material is obtained by cross-linking endogenous polyamine with Hyaluronic Acid (HA), and the endogenous polyamine includes spermine and/or spermidine. The cross-linking between the endogenous polyamine and the HA includes two-site cross-linking, three-site cross-linking, or four-site cross-linking. The various properties of the gel and degradation and release rates of the polyamine are affected by controlling reactive cross-linking sites. After the gel is subjected to moist heat sterilization, a loss rate of elastic modulus is low, such that the rheological property of the gel before sterilization may be effectively maintained, thereby greatly improving the thermal stability of the HA gel, and also improving the ease of use of the gel in fields such as soft tissue filling, soft tissue repair, medical cosmetology, etc.

column12: Photocurable hydrogel loaded with VH298-modified exosome and method of preparation and use thereof

column12: Application of gamma-ray response degradable hydrogel as biomedical material
column13: The invention discloses an application of gamma-ray response type injectable hydrogel as a biomedical material. The hydrogel takes hydroformylated hyaluronic acid and carboxymethyl chitosan as a skeleton, selenocystamine hydrochloride is introduced into a system, double-selenium bonds in the gel endow the hydrogel with gamma-ray response performance, and the gel is used as a fillable drug delivery carrier for postoperative recurrence treatment of subcutaneous tumors such as breast cancer. The hydrogel disclosed by the invention has self-repairing and injectable properties, and diselenide bonds in a gel structure can be broken by gamma rays, so that degradation in the gel is accelerated. The gel has no obvious toxic or side effect on normal skin after being filled subcutaneously, has good biocompatibility, is simple and feasible in preparation method of the monomer and the hydrogel, can be used as a promising drug delivery system, and can be combined with radiotherapy after being entrapped with an anti-tumor drug so as to achieve a good application prospect. The gel is filled into a tumor postoperative wound surface to realize tumor postoperative recurrence and metastasis treatment under gamma-ray response.

column12: Strychnine hydrogel microneedle drug delivery system as well as preparation method and application thereof
column13: The invention discloses a strychnine hydrogel microneedle drug delivery system as well as a preparation method and application thereof. The drug delivery system comprises the following components: polyvinyl alcohol, carbomer 934P, strychnine, tartaric acid and a 40% ethanol solution; the preparation method comprises the following steps: placing high polymer material polymer polyvinyl alcohol and carbomer in a beaker, uniformly mixing with a 40% ethanol solution containing strychnine medicine to fully swell, adding a tartaric acid solution, uniformly stirring, standing to fully cross-link to prepare a hydrogel solution with certain fluidity, injecting the hydrogel solution into a microneedle mold, and carrying out vacuum drying to obtain the strychnine-containing hydrogel. And centrifuging, standing in a dryer for 24 hours until water is basically completely dried, drying in a drying oven, taking out, cooling to room temperature, and demolding. The prepared hydrogel microneedle drug delivery system is good in mechanical performance, swelling performance, slow release performance and safety performance.

column12: ULTRA-HIGH THROUGHPUT ON-CHIP SYNTHESIS OF MICROGELS WITH TUNABLE MECHANICAL PROPERTIES
column13: Hydrogel particles (microgels) generated using microfluidic methods have superb properties such as high size uniformity and precise control over degradation and release profiles, making them useful for applications in wound healing and injectable drug delivery. However, the throughput of microfluidics is constrained by the physics governing the flow of immiscible fluids confined within microchannels. This throughput tends to be several orders of magnitude lower than what would be necessary for commercial and clinical applications. Here, we demonstrate the scaling up of on-chip synthesis of microgels by parallelizing the microfluidic channels. Taking advantage of the established fabrication technologies developed by the semiconductor industry and a high flow control system, a 4-inch silicon microfluidic chip integrating more than 4,000 microfluidic devices is developed. By incorporating a high energy flood UV source, this chip allows the synthesis of poly (ethylene glycol) diacrylate microgel particles with diameter down to 30 m at a throughput above Ikg/hr. By using photomasks that enable milli-second scale control of the UV exposure, the stiffness of microgels can be varied.

column13: A BMP2 surrogate protein is provided comprising two different antigen binding regions (ABR), which can be configured as immunoglobulin “single variable domains” (ISV). In some embodiments the first and second ISV are joined by a cleavable linker that is susceptible to proteases selectively expressed in monocytic cells or macrophages, relative to skeletal stem cells.

column12: Near-infrared response temperature-sensitive drug-loaded microneedle patch as well as preparation method and application thereof
column13: The invention discloses a near-infrared response temperature-sensitive drug-loaded microneedle patch as well as a preparation method and application thereof, and belongs to the field of biomedical materials. The near-infrared response temperature-sensitive drug-loaded microneedle patch comprises a bonding layer and a plurality of microneedles arranged on the bonding layer in an array mode, and drug hydrogel is loaded in the microneedles; wherein the microneedle comprises polyethylene glycol and soluble polysaccharide; the drug hydrogel comprises a temperature-sensitive material, a polymer gel material and a drug. The microneedle prepared from the polyethylene glycol and the soluble polysaccharide has enough hardness and can easily penetrate through the cuticle without pain; the drug hydrogel loaded in the microneedle can be continuously and controllably released, the effectiveness of controlled release of epidermal drugs can be prolonged, and the treatment effect is achieved; besides, the adhesive layer can be firmly adhered to the skin and is prevented from falling off in the movement process, so that the near-infrared response temperature-sensitive drug-loaded microneedle patch has a good application prospect in transdermal drug delivery.

column12: Preparation method of imine disulfide bifunctional cross-linked cyclodextrin nano hydrogel
column13: The invention provides a preparation method of imine disulfide bifunctional cross-linked cyclodextrin nano-hydrogel, the prepared nano-hydrogel has acid response and reduction response performance, the nano-hydrogel is prepared by taking cyclodextrin as a raw material and cystamine dihydrochloride as a cross-linking agent through oxidation and Schiff base reaction, and specifically, 2-iodoylbenzoic acid is taken as an oxidizing agent, and the cross-linked cyclodextrin nano-hydrogel is prepared by taking 2-iodoylbenzoic acid as a cross-linking agent through Schiff base reaction. Hydroxyl groups on cyclodextrin are oxidized into aldehyde groups, the aldehyde groups are purified through a dialysis bag, freeze-dried and directly reacted with cystamine dihydrochloride for crosslinking, the preparation process is simple, conditions are mild, and no toxicity is achieved; the prepared nano hydrogel is used for loading chemotherapeutic drugs, breaks hydrogen bonds among cyclodextrin, provides more hydrophobic spaces, can obviously improve the water solubility and stability of the chemotherapeutic drugs, has a good inhibition effect on tumor cell growth through cell level verification, improves the controlled release capability of the chemotherapeutic drugs, and has a good application prospect. The toxic and side effects on normal cells are small.

column12: Gel based on two or more microsphere complexes and preparation method thereof
column13: The invention belongs to the technical field of gel microspheres, and particularly relates to gel based on two or more microsphere complexes and a preparation method of the gel, and the gel comprises the following raw materials: acetonitrile, azodiisobutyronitrile, divinyl benzene, collagen, polyvinyl alcohol, nano-hydroxyapatite, nano-iron oxide, hydrogel, polyethelin and protein. column12: Slow-release estrogen hydrogel containing sodium alginate as well as preparation method and application thereof
column13: The invention provides slow-release estrogen hydrogel containing sodium alginate as well as a preparation method and application of the slow-release estrogen hydrogel, and belongs to the technical field of biomedical materials. The sustained-release estrogen hydrogel disclosed by the invention is prepared by crosslinking poly (hydroxyethyl methacrylate) hydrogel with metal cations; the poly (hydroxyethyl methacrylate) hydrogel contains sodium alginate. The sustained-release estrogen hydrogel is good in mechanical property, excellent in swelling resistance and high in biocompatibility, the hydrogel can provide a support needed by vaginal growth, vaginal atresia is avoided in the regeneration process, meanwhile, the hydrogel carries bioactive substance estrogen, barrier treatment and biological preparation treatment are combined, and the hydrogel has the advantages of being good in biocompatibility, good in biocompatibility, good in biocompatibility and the like. The composition can obstruct the wound surface and slowly release estrogen for promoting vaginal repair, has an excellent treatment effect of promoting postoperative rehabilitation of vaginal reconstruction, and has a wide application prospect.

column12: Preparation method and application of supramolecular hydrogel for injection
column13: The invention discloses a preparation method of supramolecular hydrogel for injection, which comprises the following steps: linking a cyclodextrin derivative and HA through a chemical bond to prepare CD-HA, and linking an AD carboxylic acid derivative and PEG through a chemical bond to prepare AD-PEG; the CD-HA, the AD-PEG and the CUR are subjected to non-covalent interaction and then are combined with anticoagulant and regeneration promoting drugs through a self-assembly strategy to prepare the supramolecular hydrogel for injection; according to the supramolecular hydrogel disclosed by the invention, accumulative release experiments find that medicines in the supramolecular hydrogel have the characteristic of graded slow release, and a mouse injury model of femoral head necrosis proves that the supramolecular hydrogel for injection can be used for effectively treating femoral head necrosis and osteoarthritis and promoting bone regeneration; a local drug delivery strategy contained in the supramolecular hydrogel for injection for treating femoral head necrosis and osteoarthritis and promoting bone regeneration aims at showing the slow release/controlled release capability and anti-inflammatory effect of the supramolecular hydrogel for injection on drugs; the supramolecular hydrogel for injection for treating femoral head necrosis and osteoarthritis and promoting bone regeneration can control inflammatory response of the femoral head part and accelerate bone regeneration to finally realize treatment of femoral head necrosis.

column12: Environment-responsive drug-loaded microspheres for treating arthritis as well as preparation method and application of environment-responsive drug-loaded microspheres
column13: The invention provides environment-responsive drug-loaded microspheres for treating arthritis as well as a preparation method and application of the environment-responsive drug-loaded microspheres. A microfluidic technology is utilized, polyethylene glycol diacrylate molecules are subjected to a polymerization reaction under the action of a photoinitiator to form a first network structure of the hydrogel, and modified polyethylene glycol and chitosan molecules are subjected to a chemical reaction to generate a Schiff base bond to form a second network structure of the hydrogel; and thus, the drug-loading microspheres with the double-network structure are constructed. The preparation method is simple, the preparation period is short, the particle size of the obtained drug-loaded microspheres is controllable, the particle size distribution is uniform, the batch is stable, and the physical and chemical properties are relatively uniform. The drug-loaded microspheres have good application value in the field of drug carriers and have a good encapsulation effect on CST-14, and the hydrogel microspheres loaded with the CST-14 have a good effect on arthritis treatment, have stimulation response performance and can release drugs according to the change of pH.

column12: MICRO AND SUPER-MICROVASCULAR ANASTOMOSIS IN A PECTIN-BASED THREE-DIMENSIONAL MATRIX GEL MEDIA THAT CAN RELEASE LIDOCAINE
column13: The invention relates to a lidocaine-loaded three-dimensional pectin-based polysaccharide gel matrix, hydrogel, for use in super micro (sub-1 mm vessels) and microsurgical sutured anastomoses. As a result of the injection of said gel matrix to the entire medium, including not only the intravascular but also the perivascular medium, and the controlled release of lidocaine (vasodilator) loaded in the gel, the shrinkage of microvessels due to vasospasm is prevented. In addition, in anastomosis applications made with said biocompatible gel matrix, vascular collapse is prevented and the need for tissue manipulation that may cause trauma to the vessels is eliminated. After application, the gel that is the subject of the invention can be easily removed from the surgical operation area without leaving any residue.

column12: BIOPOLYMER PROTECTED OLIGONUCLEOTIDES FOR DRUG DELIVERY
column13: Conjugated nucleic acid molecules and methods are provided for delivery of a therapeutic oligonucleotide. The therapeutic oligonucleotide is bonded to a nucleic acid strand having a polyadenine segment that forms a supramolecular polymer with a thymine-mimicking compound. The supramolecular polymer is configured to dissociate to release the therapeutic oligonucleotide and grant it nuclease resistance. Nuclease resistance applies sequences adjacent to the polyadenine/thymine-mimicking assembly.

column12: High-strength, high-toughness and high-water-content polyvinyl alcohol hydrogel as well as preparation method and application of alkali-induced hydroxyl deprotonation
column13: The invention relates to the technical field of new materials, and provides high-strength, high-toughness and high-water-content polyvinyl alcohol hydrogel as well as a preparation method and application of alkali-induced hydroxyl deprotonation, and the polyvinyl alcohol hydrogel is obtained by reconstructing hydrogen bond interaction between PVA molecular chains. The preparation method comprises the following steps: removing protons of part of hydroxyl in polyvinyl alcohol to obtain a PVA-O-polyanion solution; performing coordination on oxygen ions in the PVA-O-polyanion solution and alkali metal ions to obtain PVA-O-M < + > organic gel; and protonating oxygen ions in the PVA-O-M < + > organic gel to obtain the polyvinyl alcohol hydrogel. According to the preparation method of the polyvinyl alcohol hydrogel, water loss caused by violent aggregation of molecular chains in the crystal growth process is avoided, preparation of the high-strength, high-toughness and high-water-content polyvinyl alcohol hydrogel is achieved, and controllable adjustment of the mechanical property of the polyvinyl alcohol hydrogel under the high water content is achieved; and the application of the material in tissue engineering scaffolds and drug delivery carriers is promoted.

column12: Preparation method of injectable hydrogel for enhancing triple negative breast cancer chemoradiotherapy synergistic treatment
column13: The invention relates to the technical field of injectable hydrogel, in particular to a preparation method of injectable hydrogel for enhancing triple negative breast cancer chemoradiotherapy synergistic treatment. The injectable hydrogel is prepared by the following steps: coating the surface of gold nanoparticles with a layer of polydopamine film to obtain Au (at) DA, then carrying out nuclide labeling to obtain 131 I-Au (at) DA, and then loading the 131 I-Au (at) DA and GEM into CH-OD hydrogel together to obtain the 131 IAu (at) DA/GEM hydrogel. The 131IAu-coated DA/GEM hydrogel prepared by the invention can be applied to wound healing, drug delivery, tissue engineering and other medical applications due to variable physicochemical, biological and structural characteristics. Compared with local injection of free drugs or systemic administration, local drug delivery of the hydrogel can rapidly form a drug library at a target disease site, and can release drugs and reduce side effects of the drugs in a long time.

column12: Hydrogel containing nanofiber topological structure surface interface and preparation method and application thereof
column13: The invention discloses hydrogel containing a nanofiber topological structure surface interface as well as a preparation method and application of the hydrogel, and belongs to the technical field of biomedical materials. According to the preparation method provided by the invention, fiber membranes with different micro-nano topological structures are obtained through an electrostatic spinning process, plasma hydrophilic modification treatment is performed on the fiber membranes, a hydrogel precursor is imprinted by utilizing the obtained fiber membranes with the modified micro-nano topological structures, and then the hydrogel is formed through ultraviolet curing. Different micro-nano topological structures contained in a fiber membrane can be transferred to the surface interface of the prepared hydrogel in a high-fidelity manner, so that the prepared hydrogel has a nano-fiber topological structure surface interface, and the adhesion condition of in-vitro mesenchymal stem cells can be adjusted through the synergistic effect of the surface topological structure morphology and matrix modulus. The hydrogel can be widely applied to wound dressing, drug delivery and controlled release and tissue engineering.

column12: Injectable intelligent controlled-release hydrogel and application thereof in treatment of bone injury
column13: The invention belongs to the field of medicine, and relates to wound dressing, in particular to injectable intelligent controlled-release hydrogel and application thereof in treatment of bone injury, the hydrogel takes an oxidized hyaluronic acid aqueous solution and a carboxymethyl chitosan aqueous solution as matrixes, a hydrogel base material is prepared through a chemical reaction, Pht-coated ZIF-8-coated PDA is loaded in the hydrogel base material, and the hydrogel base material is prepared through an injection method. The preparation method of the Pht (at) ZIF-8 (at) PDA comprises the following steps: firstly, encapsulating Pht in ZIF-8 nanoparticles to obtain Pht (at) ZIF-8 nanoparticles; then, the surfaces of the Pht (at) ZIF-8 nano particles are wrapped with PDA (Personal Digital Assistant); wherein Pht is phloretin, ZIF-8 is a zinc-based zeolite imidazole skeleton, and PDA is polydopamine. After the hydrogel is subjected to near-infrared photothermal treatment, intelligent on-demand release and high-efficiency transportation of Pht and Zn < 2 + > are realized, so that medicines can more effectively permeate into bone tissues and are more accurately subjected to targeted administration, meanwhile, the bone repair effect can be further improved, and the repair of critical-size bone defects is realized.

column12: CATIONIC CONTACT LENS.
column13: A cationic contact lens is described as well as methods of manufacturing the same. The cationic contact lens includes a polymeric lens body that is the reaction product of a polymerizable composition that includes at least one siloxane, at least one nonionic hydrophilic monomer and at least one acyclic tertiary amine monomer. The cationic contact lens can be an unworn sterile silicone hydrogel contact lens. The contact lens is capable of substantially linear release of a releasable anionic agent and the at least one acyclic tertiary amine monomer facilitates uptake and/or sustained release of the releasable anionic agent by the polymeric lens body. The contact lens can be present in a sealed contact lens package. The sealed contact lens package can include at least a) a base member having a cavity; b) a contact lens packaging solution in the cavity; c) a unworn sterile contact lens immersed in the contact lens packaging solution in the cavity with the releasable anionic agent present; and d) a cover that forms a liquid-tight seal with the base member.

column12: COMPOSITIONS FOR GLUCOSE-RESPONSIVE DRUG DELIVERY SYSTEMS VIA MULTIFUNCTIONAL HYDROGEL-BASED MICRONEEDLE
column13: The present disclosure provides a matrix microneedle patch made of a hyaluronic acid (HA) polymeric backbone functionalized with dopamine (DA) and 4-amino-3-fluorophenylboronic acid (AFBA, pKa ~7.5) that quickly and spontaneously crosslinks upon mixing of the polymer solutions by auto-oxidation of catechol groups and reversible interactions between AFBA and catechol functional groups in the absence of any chemical crosslinking agent. The DA and AFBA content were selected for conjugation into the backbone of the HA polymer for the desired hormone delivery profile. The patch provides high drug loading capacity for long-term drug delivery application. The crosslinking mechanism for microneedle fabrication is biocompatible and beneficial for sustaining hormone drug stability and bioactivity as it does not require harsh crosslinking conditions. Facile pH adjustment of the matrix hydrogel can be easily casted into a microneedle patch without multistep processes that conventional patch polymerization requires. The present matrix microneedle patch demonstrates sufficient skin penetration, rapid swelling in interstitial media, high drug loading capacity and effective hypo/hyperglycemia prevention by the automated hypo/hyperglycemia-triggered delivery of hormones through the skin.

column12: CATIONIC CONTACT LENS
column13: A cationic contact lens is described as well as methods of manufacturing the same. column12: TWO-FIELD COUPLING CROSSLINKED, INJECTABLE, MOLDABLE AND PRINTABLE GRANULAR HYDROGEL MATERIAL, PREPARATION METHOD THEREOF AND APPLICATION THEREOF
column13: An injectable, moldable and printable gramular hydrogel material crosslinked by non-covalent and covalent bonds, a preparation method therefor, and applications thereof are provided. The gelatin particles or the particles that have core-shell structures form a continuous porous particle network by means of reversible self-assembly under the effect of the non-covalent bonds, thus achieving injectable, printable, moldable and self-healing properties. The material can be used as a drug-sustained release carrier, a tissue engineering scaffold and a tissue adhesive hemostatic material in the field of biomedicine.

column12: NEW ULTRA-MICROPOROUS CRYSTALLINE METAL ORGANIC FRAMEWORKS COMPRISING BISPHOSPHONIC ACID LIGANDS
column13: The present invention belongs to the field of nanoporous materials, in particular metal organic frameworks (MOFs) and Lewis-based gas delivery and/or slow release, or the detection of Lewis-based gas(es) in gases or liquid streams. The present invention relates, inter alia, to a new ultra-microporous crystalline metal organic framework solid ( comprising bisphosphonic acid ligands (also refered to as Phosphonate MOF), such as MIP-210(M) and uses thereof as a carrier in Lewis-based gas (such as NO) delivery. The invention also relates to controlled release of the Lewis-based gas in wounds, for example by topical application. The invention also encompasses a synthetic method for producing the new ultra- microporous crystalline metal organic framework solid of the invention. The MOFs of the present invention can be used in various applications such as gas carrier and/or for the controlled release of gas. The MOFs of the present invention thus are very versatile and have therapeutic and non therapeutic applications.

column12: Preparation method and application of blood cell active hydrogel for wound repair
column13: The invention provides a preparation method of a blood cell active hydrogel for wound repair, which comprises the following steps: preparing a hydrogel pre-polymerization solution, adding black phosphorus quantum dots into the hydrogel pre-polymerization solution, then adding a photoinitiator and polymyxin B, uniformly stirring, and then carrying out ultraviolet crosslinking to obtain a hydrogel dressing; the blood platelets and red blood cells are inoculated on the surface of the hydrogel dressing to obtain the blood cell active hydrogel, and the blood platelets are subjected to oxygen enrichment treatment before application. The blood cell hydrogel prepared by the invention acts on wounds, can effectively stop bleeding, resist bacterial infection and promote angiogenesis, collagen deposition and granulation tissue generation in wound healing, and has a remarkable effect.

column12: Boron oxygen six-ring cross-linked hydrogel and preparation method thereof

After the polymer is exposed to water, a 2-hydroxyphenylboronic acid structure in the polymer is quickly converted into a 2-hydroxyphenylboronic acid trimer structure at room temperature, and the 2-hydroxyphenylboronic acid trimer structure is a novel structure with water-stable boron oxygen six rings. Through a boron-oxygen-six-ring structure, polymer chains are crosslinked to form a network structure, and then the hydrogel is formed.
