column12: Si- Ni Si- Ni Making Method For Si-Based Ni Nanoflower-Encapsulated Microsphere Si-Based Ni Nanoflower-Encapsulated Microsphere Using The Same And Bactericide Method
column13: The rapid emergence of antibiotic resistance in pathogenic microorganisms threatens global public health. To alleviate this burgeoning problem, topical application of antibiotics can serve as an attractive solution. To achieve this, materials must be fabricated as carriers. Hydrogels have various physical and chemical properties and are promising materials for topical antimicrobial applications by mimicking the extracellular matrix. In the present invention, antimicrobial silicon (Si)-based nickel (Ni) nanoflowers (Si@Ni) were synthesized and encapsulated in gelatin methacryloyl (GelMA) using microfluidics and photocrosslinking techniques to form uniformly microsized hydrogel spheres (Si@Ni -GelMA). X-ray diffraction, transmission electron microscopy, and scanning electron microscopy were used to characterize Si@Ni and Si@Ni-GelMA. Injectable Si@Ni-GelMA exhibited excellent antibacterial properties against three different bacterial strains (Pseudomonas aeruginosa, Klebsiella pneumoniae, and methicillin-resistant Staphylococcus aureus, wherein the bacterial killing rate is more than 99.9 %). Also, negligible toxicity against mouse embryonic fibroblast cells was exhibited. Therefore, Si@Ni-GelMA could be potentially applied as a drug delivery carrier due to the injectability, visible-light-activated cross-linking, degradation, biosafety, and excellent antibacterial properties thereof.

column12: Sodium alginate/carbon dot composite hydrogel material as well as preparation method and application thereof
column13: The invention relates to a sodium alginate/carbon dot composite hydrogel material, a preparation method thereof and application of the sodium alginate/carbon dot composite hydrogel material as an adsorbent and a sustained-release material to adsorb copper ions in soil and release nutrient element calcium ions to the soil. Soaking the sodium alginate hydrogel balls in a carbon dot solution synthesized by malic acid and urea for 4-10 hours, repeatedly washing the sodium alginate hydrogel balls with deionized water until no residual carbon dot solution is left on the surfaces of the hydrogel balls, and drying the hydrogel balls in a blast dryer at 60-80 DEG C for 6-24 hours to obtain a product sodium alginate/carbon dot composite hydrogel material; the mass ratio of the sodium alginate hydrogel balls to the carbon dots is 800: (1-10), and the concentration of the carbon dot solution is 0.5-5g/L. The copper ion removal agent is used for removing copper ions in soil, the removal rate reaches 57.4%-72%, and the calcium increasing amount is 48.5%-65.7%. The method is used for removing copper ions in polluted water, and the removal rate is greater than 85%. The preparation method is simple and low in cost, the material is an environment-friendly material and is green in synthesis, and the sodium alginate/carbon dot composite hydrogel material has a good adsorption effect on copper ions and effectively releases a certain amount of nutrient element calcium ions to soil.

column12: Hydrogel microcapsule for targeted drug delivery of neogambogic acid and preparation method of hydrogel microcapsule

The preparation method comprises the following steps: uniformly dispersing magnetic nanoparticles into a sodium alginate solution to form a magnetic sodium alginate solution; the mass ratio of the magnetic nanoparticles to the sodium alginate solution is (1-3): (10-15); the preparation method comprises the following steps: constructing a micro-channel, injecting a neogambogic acid solution and a magnetic sodium alginate solution at the same time at the first end of the micro-channel, then injecting 50CPS silicone oil and a calcium chloride solution into the micro-channel, finally applying a static magnetic field, and collecting at the second end of the micro-channel to obtain the hydrogel microcapsule for neogambogic acid targeted drug delivery. According to the hydrogel microcapsule prepared by the method, the size of a drug delivery system can be controlled, the hydrogel microcapsule can directionally move to a targeted position, the drug is slowly released, and the drug concentration of a targeted area is ensured for a long time.

column12: NA/CNs (at) Zein composite injectable self-assembly gel material as well as preparation method and application thereof
column13: The invention relates to the field of composite materials, in particular to an NACNs-Zein composite injectable self-assembly gel material as well as a preparation method and application thereof. The preparation method comprises the following steps: adding mesoporous carbon nanospheres loaded with a loaded drug into a modified zein gel precursor, and uniformly stirring to obtain the NA/CNs Zein composite injectable self-assembled gel. The zein is injectable by utilizing the special dissolving property of the zein, the zein can be self-assembled to form adhesive gel after meeting water, and the medicine can be continuously and controllably released at the affected part through the photo-thermal response of the carbon spheres. Compared with a traditional hydrogel material, the composite gel material has the advantages that the surgical implantation process is avoided, the treatment steps are greatly simplified, the treatment cost is greatly reduced, the treatment experience of a patient is improved, and the composite gel material has good biocompatibility, self-degradability and a stable structure and can be applied to clinical treatment of in-vivo tissue damage in the medical field.

column12: Temperature-sensitive Hydrogel NIR-controlled Drug Releasing Type Drug Delivery System and Manufacturing Method Thereof
column13: The present invention relates to a temperature-sensitive hydrogel, a drug or dye carrier comprising the same, and a method for producing the same. The temperature-sensitive hydrogel can be produced by synthesizing Prussian blue through layered assembly on poly(N-isopropylacrylamide) having a carboxyl group introduced on the surface, and the hydrogel can be used as an infrared controlled-release drug or dye carrier with excellent biocompatibility. The carrier of the present invention increases the amount of Prussian blue introduced by synthesizing Prussian blue on the polymer surface through layered assembly. Also, the phenomenon of the particles of the Prussian blue being eluted can be provided and the release rate of not only drugs but also various dyes can be controlled. The present invention provides a drug or dye carrier that enables infrared controlled release by producing a hydrogel and loading a drug or dye into the hydrogel, and a method for producing the same.

column12: Electro-mechanically stretched micro fibers and methods of use thereof
column13: The presently disclosed subject matter provides a scalable and electrostretching approach for generating hydrogel microfibers exhibiting uniaxial alignment from aqueous polymer solutions. Such hydrogel microfibers can be generated from a variety of water-soluble natural polymers or synthetic polymers. The hydrogel microfibers can be used for controlled release of bioactive agents. The internal uniaxial alignment exhibited by the presently disclosed hydrogel fibers provides improved mechanical properties to hydrogel microfibers, and contact guidance cues and induces alignment for cells seeded on or within the hydrogel microfibers.

column12: GALLOL-CONJUGATED ALDEHYDE-MODIFIED HYALURONIC ACID AND USE THEREOF
column13: The present invention relates to an aldehyde-conjugated hyaluronic acid derivative modified with a gallol group and use thereof. According to one embodiment of the present invention, since the aldehyde-conjugated hyaluronic acid derivative modified with a gallol group significantly reduces an extrusion force required for injection in comparison with that of a conventional gallol-modified hyaluronic acid-based hydrogel, a change in intramuscular pressure in the fascia is small during intramuscular injection, such that pain due to the intramuscular injection can be minimized, thereby minimizing pain and stress due to repeated drug administration and improving quality of life for elderly patients. In addition, delivering extracellular matrices derived from various tissues is possible, thereby being applied to drug delivery, tissue suture, therapeutic agents, etc.

column12: Gold nanoparticle/cis-platinum bi-crosslinking polyamino acid hydrogel as well as preparation method and application thereof
column13: The invention provides gold nanoparticle/cis-platinum bi-crosslinked polyamino acid hydrogel as well as a preparation method and application thereof. The gold nanoparticle/cis-platinum bi-crosslinked polyamino acid hydrogel is prepared from a chemotherapeutic drug cis-platinum, gold nanoparticles, a polyamino acid block polymer containing carboxyl functional groups and terminal mercaptan or selenol and a solvent. Wherein the polyamino acid block polymer comprises cysteamine or seleno-cysteamine and a polyamino acid chain segment. The preparation method comprises the following steps: firstly, constructing amino acid modified gold nanoparticles through sulfur-gold or selenium-gold bonds; furthermore, the semi-solid hydrogel is obtained by utilizing the coordination effect of the carboxyl functional group and a cis-platinum drug. The nano-composite hydrogel co-drug-loading system disclosed by the invention is sodium alginate hydrogel in which drug-loading nanoparticles encapsulated by hyaluronic acid are embedded. The drug-loaded nanoparticles encapsulate an anthracycline chemotherapeutic drug and a tyrosine kinase inhibitor; an anthracycline chemotherapeutic drug is connected to a hyaluronic acid side chain through a hydrazone bond to form a polymer prodrug, and a tyrosine kinase inhibitor is self-assembled and encapsulated into a nanoparticle hydrophobic core through a polymer prodrug molecule to obtain the hyaluronic acid encapsulated drug-loaded nanoparticle. The nano composite hydrogel co-drug delivery system is easy for intratumoral and para-tumoral injection, can be slowly degraded in vivo, and synchronously delivers drugs to tumor cells in a targeting manner by using escaped nanoparticles, thereby inhibiting proliferation, invasion and migration of the tumor cells and realizing a synergistic anti-tumor effect.

column12: Biodegradable polymer formulations for extended efficacy of botulinum toxin
column13: Methods for the formulation of biodegradable microparticles for delivery of protein drugs, such as botulinum toxin, have been developed. The methods include the steps of precipitating and washing proteins with organic solvent to remove water prior to dispersing in polymer-dissolved organic solvent to prevent exposure to water/solvent interfaces and maintain bioactivity of the protein drugs and fabrication of microparticles by either template or emulsion method. Biodegradable microparticles, formed of one or more biodegradable polymers having entrapped in the polymer one or more protein agents, such as botulinum toxin, are also provided. Precipitated botulinum toxin and botulinum toxin-loaded microparticles can also be formulated into thermogels or crosslinked hydrogels. The stability of the protein within these microparticles, as well as the controlled release of the entrapped agents, provides for sustained efficacy of the agents.

column12: Preparation method of semi-interpenetrating network hydrogel based on amino-succinimide ring-opening reaction
column13: The invention discloses a preparation method of semi-interpenetrating network hydrogel based on amino-succinimide ring-opening reaction, which comprises the following steps: firstly, modifying polysuccinimide by using an amino-containing hydrophilic compound such as tris (hydroxymethyl) aminomethane to obtain a water-soluble polysuccinimide polymer; the preparation method comprises the following steps: reacting N-vinyl caprolactam with 3-mercaptopropionic acid to obtain a carboxyl-terminated poly (N-vinyl caprolactam) polymer, and grafting hydroxypropyl methyl cellulose with the polymer to obtain the macromolecular hydroxypropyl methyl cellulose derivative. The preparation method comprises the following steps: dissolving water-soluble polysuccinimide, an amino-containing polymer and a hydroxypropyl methyl cellulose derivative in water, carrying out a ring-opening reaction on amino-succinimide to obtain hydrogel, soaking with water to remove non-crosslinked components, and drying to obtain the semi-interpenetrating network hydrogel. The preparation process is simple, the conditions are mild, the reaction speed is high, and the prepared hydrogel has pH/temperature sensitivity and can be used in the fields of tissue engineering, drug sustained release, water treatment and the like.

column12: Preparation method and application of self-healing antibacterial pain-relieving gelatin hydrogel wound dressing
column13: The invention discloses a preparation method and application of a self-healing antibacterial pain-relieving gelatin hydrogel wound dressing. The preparation method of the hydrogel wound dressing comprises the following steps: blowing air to oxidize phenolic groups of tannic acid into quinonyl groups, carrying out Michael addition reaction on the quinonyl groups and amino groups of gelatin, continuously adjusting the pH value by using a NaOH solution in the reaction process, controlling the pH value of a reaction solution to be 7-10, cooling to room temperature after the reaction is finished, adjusting the pH value to be neutral by using an HCl solution, and carrying out freeze drying to obtain the hydrogel wound dressing. The tannic acid-gelatin hydrogel precursor solution is obtained. And reacting the tannic acid-gelatin hydrogel precursor solution with the beta-cyclodextrin tetracaine inclusion compound to obtain the self-healing antibacterial pain-relieving gelatin hydrogel wound dressing. The hydrogel wound dressing prepared by the invention can provide a moist wound environment, has excellent self-healing performance, excellent antibacterial performance and long drug sustained release time, can relieve pain while promoting wound healing, and also has good biocompatibility, quick effect and good effect.

column12: Three-dimensional mesh-like hydrogel and manufacturing method thereof capable of increasing treatment effects and reducing side effects of epidermal irritation
column13: The present invention provides a three-dimensional mesh-like hydrogel and a manufacturing method thereof. Firstly, water-soluble polymers are added into and uniformly mixed with a solvent, and hydrolyzed to form a sol, which is then transformed into a gel through a vacuum process. A three-dimensional mesh-like hydrogel is formed through polycondensation reaction. The three-dimensional mesh-like hydrogel is composed of water-soluble polymers. The water-soluble polymers include a group composed of sodium alginate and sodium carboxymethyl cellulose. The water-soluble polymers are interconnected to form a three-dimensional mesh structure. Thereby, the three-dimensional mesh-like hydrogel of the present invention serves as a gel coating agent. By using the high molecular polymer to form a three-dimensional mesh structure for encapsulating drugs, active ingredients can be more effectively protected to achieve a sustained-release effect, and furthermore, treatment effects can be increased and side effects of epidermal irritation can be reduced.

The preparation method of the microneedle patch is simple and convenient, and the safety of raw materials is high. The drug has sensitive glucose concentration responsiveness and a long-acting controllable release process, the treatment process is painless and minimally invasive, the risk of hypoglycemia is effectively avoided, the bioavailability of the drug is improved, and the treatment risk and side effects caused by subcutaneous injection of insulin can be reduced.

The sealed contact lens package may include at least a) a base member having a cavity; b) a contact lens packaging solution in the cavity; c) an unworn sterile contact lens impregnated in the contact lens packaging solution in the cavity in the presence of a releasable anionic agent; and d) a cover forming a liquid-tight seal with the base member.

column12: Compositions and related methods for targeted drug delivery
column13: Compositions, articles, and methods for targeted drug delivery, such as thermoresponsive hydrogel polymers, are generally provided. In some cases, the compositions described herein have advantageous combinations of properties including mechanical strength, biocompatibility, tunable charge densities, thermal responsiveness, drug loading, and/or configurations for targeted drug delivery. In one embodiment, the composition comprises a solution comprising a thermoresponsive polymer including one or more ligands attached to the polymer, wherein the solution is configured to undergo a sol-to-gel transition under physiological conditions. In another embodiment, the composition comprises a plurality of nanoparticles e.g., associated with the thermoresponsive polymer. In yet another embodiment, the composition comprises a therapeutic agent e.g., associated with the nanoparticles and/or thermoresponsive polymer.

column12: Preparation method and application of composite hydrogel based on bioadhesive nanoparticles
column13: The invention belongs to the technical field of biological medicine, and particularly relates to a preparation method and application of composite hydrogel based on bioadhesive nanoparticles. column12: Thermosensitive modified chitosan hydrogel and preparation method thereof
column13: The invention discloses temperature-sensitive modified chitosan hydrogel and a preparation method thereof. The temperature-sensitive modified chitosan hydrogel is chitosan jointly modified by hydroxybutyl and polyphenol. The preparation method comprises the following steps: firstly, by taking 1, 2-epoxybutane as an etherifying agent, introducing hydroxybutyl on a chitosan molecular chain; secondly, in the polyphenol part, free amino groups of hydroxybutyl chitosan and carboxyl groups of gallic acid are subjected to condensation reaction to introduce polyphenol groups; the polyphenol modified chitosan aqueous solution is in a solution flowing state at low temperature and can be injected for use, and when the temperature rises to about 37 DEG C, thermo-sensitive hydrogel can be formed. Due to the introduction of polyphenol groups, the oxidation resistance and tissue adhesion capacity of the material are improved. The polyphenol modified chitosan component prepared by the method is high in safety and good in biocompatibility, and has a wide application prospect in the fields of drug delivery, tissue engineering, cell culture and the like.

The HPCD adjusts the formation of the gel and has various microstructures such as a disordered rod-shaped structure, a thin-layer structure and an HPCD molecular cavity, and an X-ray diffraction (XRD) result reflects the amorphous characteristic of the composite xerogel; the results of Fourier transform infrared spectroscopy (FT-IR) and differential scanning calorimetry (DSC) prove that the supramolecular interaction between the KGM and the KGM is mainly based on hydrogen-bond interaction in a gel network; a rheological test shows that the elasticity modulus (G ') of the composite hydrogel is increased due to the existence of the HPCD; levofloxacin is loaded in the composite hydrogel by using an inhibition zone method, so that the composite hydrogel has a relatively good antibacterial effect. The research has important significance for developing a better drug delivery system in academic and pharmaceutical industries.

column12: Methotrexate-loaded hyaluronic acid hydrogel as well as preparation method and application thereof
column13: The invention discloses methotrexate-loaded hyaluronic acid hydrogel as well as a preparation method and application thereof, and relates to the technical field of biological medicines. The preparation method of the methotrexate-loaded hyaluronic acid hydrogel comprises the following steps: (1) coupling hyaluronic acid and dopamine under the action of a coupling agent under an acidic condition to generate hyaluronic acid-dopamine; and (2) after the phenolic hydroxyl group of the hyaluronic acid-dopamine is oxidized, cross-linking with methotrexate under an alkaline condition to form the methotrexate-loaded hyaluronic acid hydrogel. The invention also provides an application of the methotrexate-loaded hyaluronic acid hydrogel in preparation of a medicine for treating osteoarthritis. The methotrexate-loaded hyaluronic acid hydrogel is synthesized, and the hydrogel can effectively relieve OA joint synovitis and cartilage defects through drug sustained release, ROS generation removal and macrophage M1/M2 polarization adjustment, and has good biological safety.

column12: Perfusion enabled bioreactors
column13: Disclosed herein is a bioreactor system that allows active perfusive flow through a porous support medium enabling 3D growth of biological samples. In some embodiments, the system comprises a sample well filled with a three-dimensional (3D) cell growth medium. The system can further comprise a liquid medium reservoir fluidly connected to the sample well by a first filter material. The system can further comprises a medium collection chamber fluidly connected to the sample well by a second filter material. In some embodiments, application of negative gage pressure to the medium collection chamber or positive pressure to the liquid medium reservoir draws fluid from the liquid medium reservoir, through the first filter material, into the sample well where it permeates the three-dimensional cell growth medium, through the second filter material, and finally into the medium collection chamber.

The bone-targeted oral micro-nano hydrogel microspheres can realize the functions of oral delivery, gastric protection, intestinal slow/controlled release, active targeting of bone tissues and the like, can significantly improve the intestinal absorption rate and bioavailability of deferoxamine drugs, can activate an HIF-1alpha/VEGF signal channel to promote H-type angiogenesis, meanwhile, promotes the expression of heme oxygenase-1, inhibits bone resorption, and improves the bioavailability of deferoxamine drugs. column12: Exploiting oxygen inhibited photopolymerization within emulsion droplets for the fabrication of microparticles with customizable properties
column13: Described are methods and devices for the generation of hydrogel particles with micrometer and submicrometer dimensions using oxygen-inhibited partial polymerization, and the particles generated therefrom. The described methods generate particles with dimensions independent of the starting polymerizable solution dimension, for example, a microdroplet. Further, microfluidic flow parameters (e.g. viscosity, flow rate) and photopolymerization process parameters (e.g. optical exposure intensity and duration) are controlled to generate particles with tunable crosslinking density-determined properties including elasticity, diffusivity, and biomolecular display for diverse applications such as drug delivery, tissue engineering cell scaffolds, and single- and multiple- cell therapeutics. Similarly, gradients of crosslinking density-determined properties can be created within single particles through the selection of optical exposure intensity and duration. In addition to conventional spherical shapes, a suite of non-spherical shapes may be generated by manipulating the dimensions of the microfluidic channels and other related physical and process parameters.

column12: Biodegradable hydrogel as well as preparation method and application thereof
column13: The invention belongs to the technical field of biological medicine, and particularly relates to biodegradable hydrogel as well as a preparation method and application thereof. The hydrogel provided by the invention has biodegradable and injectable characteristics, and is synthesized in one step through ring opening polymerization by taking a polyethylene glycol polymer as an initiator and taking lactide, glycolide and cyclic oxalate as monomers. Due to the temperature-responsive sol-gel transition behavior, the hydrogel can be injected into the body to form gel. The introduction of oxalate groups in the hydrogel endows the hydrogel with hydrogen peroxide responsive degradation capability, and can cause responsive fracture of a hydrogel skeleton in a focus microenvironment. column12: Rosmarinic acid-chitosan-polyvinyl alcohol hydrogel dressing as well as preparation method and application thereof
column13: The invention belongs to the technical field of biological medicines, and particularly relates to a rosmarinic acid-chitosan-polyvinyl alcohol hydrogel dressing as well as a preparation method and application thereof. The preparation method comprises the following steps: dissolving chitosan in acetic acid at room temperature, and dissolving polyvinyl alcohol in deionized water; and then mixing and stirring the chitosan solution and the polyvinyl alcohol solution. column12: INJECTABLE SHEAR-THINNING HYDROGEL CONTAINING POLYPEPTIDE THERAPEUTIC AGENT FOR ENHANCED TUMOR THERAPY
column13: We have developed novel shear-thinning biomaterials using silica nanoparticles, gelatin-based polymers and polypeptides such as anti-PD-1 antibodies. Shear-thinning biomaterial technology offers enables polymers and drugs loaded inside such polymers to be easily delivered directly through catheters into target area for use, for example, in cancer therapy and immunotherapy. When a force above a certain threshold is applied to inject such materials, they "thin" and behaves as a semi-solid, allowing the material to readily flow through a catheter. When the force is removed, the material instantly becomes a soft solid with significant cohesive properties that prevent it from dislodging or breaking up.

column12: System and method for manufacturing polymer coated controlled release fertilizers
column13: A system and method are provided for manufacturing the polymer-coated fertilizers with a controlled release in a single pass. A collector mechanism receives the encapsulated articles from the second chill roll.

column12: OPIOID INDEPENDENT SURGICAL ANESTHETIC
column13: An opioid independent surgical anesthetic composition includes an injectable dosage form of a hydrogel having a plurality of solid lipid matrix particles entrapped therein. The solid lipid matrix particles include a lipophilic local anesthetic drug and a lipid glyceride (e.g., saturated triglyceride or lipid blend of various lipid glycerides). Methods for creating a long-acting local anesthetic product can include creating a bulk solid of a lipid matrix product by heating a lipid solvent above its melting point, dissolving a lipophilic local anesthetic drug therein, reducing a temperature of the resultant drug-lipid solution to below the melting point of the lipid solvent, and heat annealing the lipid matrix to remove or reduce presence of any unstable polymorphs in the lipid matrix. The methods can further include crushing the bulk solid of the lipid matrix product to form solid lipid matrix particles and entrapping the solid lipid matrix particles within a hydrogel.

column12: Hydrogel robot and preparation method and application thereof

column12: Preparation method of pH-responsive polypeptide gelatin hybrid hydrogel
column13: The invention discloses polypeptide gelatin hybrid hydrogel and a preparation method thereof. The preparation method comprises the following steps: carrying out heat treatment on a pH (Potential of Hydrogen) response type self-assembled polypeptide Ac-Ph-Ala-Leu-Asn-Leu-Ala-Lys-Asp-NH2 (PEP-1) with biodegradability and gelatin in a phosphate buffer solution (PBS) to form a hybrid hydrogel, and coating an anti-cancer drug with the hybrid hydrogel. The hybrid hydrogel prepared by the invention has pH responsiveness, can form gel in a weak alkaline environment and sol in a weak acid environment, and meets the requirements of intelligent anti-cancer drug carrier materials. The preparation method disclosed by the invention is simple in steps, can form gel only by mixing, stirring, heating and standing, and is not easy to deteriorate. The injectability of the hybrid hydrogel can be adjusted by changing the ratio of PEP-1/gelatin to PBS. The release rate of the medicine can be adjusted by changing the ratio of PEP-1 to gelatin. The hydrogel has high encapsulation efficiency and drug loading capacity on anti-cancer drugs, and can effectively slow down burst release of the drugs and prolong the half-life period.

column12: AMPHIPHILIC OLIGOMERS AND SELF-ASSEMBLING HYDROGELS FORMED THEREFROM
column13: Amphiphilic oligomers are provided that yield self-assembled, phase-separated hydrogels suitable for sustained release drug delivery. The oligomers are of formula (D-C-A-C)n-B or (D-C-B-C)n-A, where A represents a hydrophilic segment such as polyethylene glycol, B is a degradable hydrophobic segment such as polycaprolactone, C is a linking group comprising a urethane or urea linkage, D is a terminal catechol adhesive group capable of cross- linking, and n is 2 or 3. The oligomers are prepared by (i) reacting either one of a hydrophilic polyol or a hydrophobic polyol with a diisocyanate compound; (ii) reacting the product of step (i) with the other of the hydrophilic polyol and hydrophobic polyol; and (iii) reacting the product of step (ii) with a catechol derivative to form the terminal adhesive groups.

column12: ULTRA-HIGH THROUGHPUT ON-CHIP SYNTHESIS OF MICROGELS WITH TUNABLE MECHANICAL PROPERTIES
column13: Hydrogel particles (microgels) generated using microfluidic methods have superb properties such as high size uniformity and precise control over degradation and release profiles, making them useful for applications in wound healing and injectable drug delivery. However, the throughput of microfluidics is constrained by the physics governing the flow of immiscible fluids confined within microchannels. This throughput tends to be several orders of magnitude lower than what would be necessary for commercial and clinical applications. Here, we demonstrate the scaling up of on-chip synthesis of microgels by parallelizing the microfluidic channels. Taking advantage of the established fabrication technologies developed by the semiconductor industry and a high flow control system, a 4-inch silicon microfluidic chip integrating more than 4,000 microfluidic devices is developed. By incorporating a high energy flood UV source, this chip allows the synthesis of poly ( ethylene glycol) di acrylate microgel particles with diameter down to 30 mat a throughput above Ikg/hr. By using photomasks that enable milli-second scale control of the UV exposure, the stiffness of microgels can be varied.

column12: THERMORESPONSIVE HYDROGELS AS MICRONICHES FOR THE GROWTH AND CONTROLLED RELEASE OF PLURIPOTENT STEM CELLS AND PREPARATION METHOD THEREOF
column13: The present invention relates to a thermoresponsive hydrogel, comprising dendritic polyglycerol units and poly(N-isopropylacrylamide)-co-polyethylene glycol units that are covalently bound to each other via a linker, wherein the linker is chosen from the group consisting of a cyclic triazol moiety and a diazacyclohexadiene moiety. This thermoresponsive hydrogel serves as microniche environment for the robust cultivation of cells such as induced pluripotent stem cells. The thermoresponsive hydrogel has a specific thermoreversible degradation capability enabling a controlled release of the expanded cells by only changing the temperature. This dramatically simplifies the process of cell harvesting.

column12: Drug sustained-release hydrogel as well as preparation method and application thereof
column13: The invention relates to a preparation method of drug sustained-release hydrogel. The preparation method comprises the following steps: adding polyvinyl alcohol into water, and stirring to prepare a polyvinyl alcohol solution; the preparation method comprises the following steps: dissolving a hydrophobic drug in absolute ethyl alcohol to prepare an absolute ethyl alcohol solution of the hydrophobic drug; the hydrophobic drug is selected from quercetin or myricetin; the preparation method comprises the following steps: ultrasonically mixing an absolute ethyl alcohol solution of a hydrophobic drug and a polyvinyl alcohol solution to prepare a drug-polyvinyl alcohol mixed solution; and standing and volatilizing the ethanol in the medicine-polyvinyl alcohol mixed solution to remove the ethanol, thereby obtaining the medicine sustained-release hydrogel. The drug sustained-release hydrogel is prepared by the preparation method. The drug sustained-release hydrogel can be applied to injectable materials, postoperative adhesion prevention materials, drug delivery materials, bone regeneration materials or wound repair materials. The problem that quercetin and myricetin are poor in water solubility is solved, the preparation method is carried out at normal temperature, it is avoided that under the high-temperature heating condition, drugs are prone to oxidation, and consequently the performance of the drugs is lost, and the activity of the drugs is easily kept.

column12: Application of hydrogel carrier in drug sustained release
column13: The invention belongs to the field of hydrogel materials, and particularly relates to application of a hydrogel carrier in drug sustained release. The preparation method comprises the following steps: firstly, dipping organic gel into a medicine-containing solution to carry medicines, so as to obtain medicine-carrying organic gel; and dipping the drug-loaded organogel in water or an aqueous solution for solvent exchange to obtain the drug-loaded hydrogel. According to the drug carrier based on the hydrophobic hydrogel, the material is extremely high in water content and good in biocompatibility. Due to a phase-separated compact structure and a special swelling behavior, the material can effectively improve the drug loading capacity and reduce the drug release speed. column12: Injectable self-healing hydrogel with dual response to temperature and pH as well as preparation method and application of injectable self-healing hydrogel
column13: The invention belongs to the technical field of biological materials and biomedical engineering, and particularly relates to injectable self-healing hydrogel with dual response to temperature and pH as well as a preparation method and application thereof.The injectable self-healing hydrogel with dual response to temperature and pH is prepared by cross-linking aldehyde modified oxidized hyaluronic acid and F127 grafted chitosan oligosaccharide to form a Schiff base bond, and by adding the chitosan oligosaccharide, the Schiff base bond effect is enhanced, so that the injectable self-healing hydrogel with dual response to temperature and pH is prepared. The injectable hydrogel is formed through the combined action of hydrogen bonds between the boric acid and the oxidized hyaluronic acid; the hydrogel prepared by the invention can be injected in situ, can be used for filling irregular diabetic foot wounds, and is beneficial to good integration with surrounding tissues; chitosan oligosaccharide and hyaluronic acid in the hydrogel have good biocompatibility and biodegradability, and are beneficial to repair of diabetic foot wounds. The pH responsiveness can be used for dynamically detecting the acid-base property of the wound surface and plays a role in responding to the sustained-release medicine; the self-healing property can be recovered after the hydrogel is broken, so that the treatment effect of the hydrogel is improved.

column13: A hydrogel-based biological delivery vehicle used to effectively deliver drug and biological material to tissue or organ sites. column12: Hydrogel type tissue engineering scaffold with biphase drug sustained release function, photocuring 3D printing preparation method thereof and photosensitive resin

column12: Temperature-sensitive hydrogel for local slow-release delivery of minocycline hydrochloride and preparation method of temperature-sensitive hydrogel
column13: The invention discloses a minocycline hydrochloride temperature-sensitive hydrogel for local sustained-release delivery and a preparation method thereof, and belongs to the technical field of medicine preparation. The hydrogel disclosed by the invention combines the advantages of both metal ion complexing and temperature-sensitive hydrogel, not only utilizes the characteristic that metal ions are complexed with a metal-philic drug to improve the stability, but also combines the unique property of temperature-sensitive gel solution-gel transformation and a highly hydrophilic three-dimensional grid structure, so that the drug is adhered to the local part of the drug, and the stability of the drug is improved. Moreover, high-concentration long-acting release of local medicines can be maintained, the administration frequency is reduced, adverse reactions of the medicines are reduced to a certain extent, and the utilization rate of the medicines is greatly improved.

The hydrogel is thus suitable for use in the fields of biomedicine, medical cosmetic plastic surgery and cosmetics.

The hydrogel comprises a hydrogel solution, a drug carrier and a drug active component, and is prepared from the following raw materials in parts by weight: 3-20 parts of QCSG, 1-20 parts of rColMA, 0.05-5 parts of a photoinitiator and 90-110 parts of a solvent. The preparation method comprises the following steps: dissolving chitosan quaternary ammonium salt in water, dropwise adding glycidyl methacrylate for reaction, filtering, taking filtrate, dialyzing and freeze-drying to obtain QCSG; and dissolving the recombinant collagen in water, dropwise adding glycidyl methacrylate for reaction, dialyzing and freeze-drying to obtain the rColMA. The hydrogel can effectively inhibit bacteria, has excellent antibacterial and anti-inflammatory properties, is better in biocompatibility, has proper swelling ratio, stable rheological property, slow biodegradability, proper mechanical property and drug sustained release property, and can be widely applied to drug loading systems.

The material is simple in preparation method and high in biological safety and curative effect, and has important medical application value.

column12: PH-responsive 3D printing drug controlled release hydrogel as well as preparation method and application thereof
column13: The invention provides pH-responsive 3D printing drug controlled release hydrogel as well as a preparation method and application thereof, and belongs to the field of intelligent hydrogel. Providing a polymer solution; providing a carbomer solution; providing a model drug solution; mixing the polymer solution, the carbomer solution and the model drug solution to obtain 3D printing ink; a 3D printing hydrogel model is constructed, and the internal filling shape of the 3D printing hydrogel model is in a honeycomb shape; the 3D printing hydrogel model is converted into a G code; according to the G code, 3D printing ink is subjected to 3D printing, after a sample is obtained, freezing and normal-temperature standing are sequentially conducted, and the pH response 3D printing medicine controlled release hydrogel is obtained. The pH response 3D printing medicine controlled release hydrogel does not swell or even deswell in the stomach, so that the release rate of the medicine is relatively low, and when the hydrogel passes through the intestinal tract, the release rate of the medicine is increased along with the increase of the swelling degree due to the increase of the pH value, so that the controllable release of the medicine in the intestinal tract can be realized.

column12: Purpurine hydrogel/magnesium self-powered on-demand drug delivery device and application thereof in psoriasis treatment
column13: The invention discloses a viologen hydrogel/magnesium self-powered on-demand drug delivery device and application thereof in psoriasis treatment, and belongs to the technical field of functional polymer materials. According to the invention, a drug-loaded viologen hydrogel prepared from a double-bond functionalized viologen monomer, an acrylamide monomer and N, N-methylene bisacrylamide in a free radical polymerization manner is used as a positive electrode of the biological battery, a magnesium rod is used as a negative electrode, and a polyvinyl alcohol/phosphoric acid buffer salt solution is used as a solid electrolyte; the integrated self-powered on-demand drug delivery device is assembled and prepared and is applied to the field of psoriasis treatment. The output voltage of the device ranges from 1.46 V to 1.48 V, the purpose of on-demand drug delivery is achieved by changing the resistance value of the load resistor during use, no extra power source is needed, and the device has huge application potential in the field of psoriasis treatment.

The compound has good biocompatibility and degradability, and is high in safety. Through the injectable sustained-release analgesic compound, analgesic requirements and management of nerve block and local incision infiltration of postoperative patients are facilitated, related postoperative complications are reduced, and rapid recovery of the patients is promoted.

column12: Cationic contact lens
column13: A cationic contact lens is described as well as methods of manufacturing the same. The cationic contact lens includes a polymeric lens body that is the reaction product of a polymerizable composition that includes at least one siloxane, at least one nonionic hydrophilic monomer and at least one acyclic tertiary amine monomer. The cationic contact lens can be an unworn sterile silicone hydrogel contact lens. The contact lens is capable of substantially linear release of a releasable anionic agent and the at least one acyclic tertiary amine monomer facilitates uptake and/or sustained release of the releasable anionic agent by the polymeric lens body. The contact lens can be present in a sealed contact lens package. The sealed contact lens package can include at least (a) a base member having a cavity; (b) a contact lens packaging solution in the cavity; (c) a unworn sterile contact lens immersed in the contact lens packaging solution in the cavity with the releasable anionic agent present; and (d) a cover that forms a liquid-tight seal with the base member.

column12: OPIOID INDEPENDENT SURGICAL ANESTHETIC
column13: An opioid independent surgical anesthetic composition includes an injectable dosage form of a hydrogel having a plurality of solid lipid matrix particles entrapped therein. The methods can further include crushing the bulk solid of the lipid matrix product to form solid lipid matrix particles and entrapping the solid lipid matrix particles within a hydrogel.

column12: Preparation method of acid-sensitive cross-linked cyclodextrin nano-hydrogel drug delivery system with controllable particle size and controllable degradation
column13: The invention relates to a preparation method of an acid-sensitive cross-linked cyclodextrin nano-hydrogel drug delivery system with controllable particle size and controllable degradation, which comprises the following steps: by taking alpha, beta and gamma-cyclodextrin as units, protecting 1-2 hydroxyls on the alpha, beta and gamma-cyclodextrin, methylating and ethylating other hydroxyls, and then deprotecting to obtain the acid-sensitive cross-linked cyclodextrin nano-hydrogel drug delivery system with controllable particle size and controllable degradation. Ethylene glycol, glycerol, pentaerythritol, pentanol, cyclohexanehexol and the like are used as cross-linking agents, hydroxyl groups of molecules such as ethylene glycol, glycerol, pentaerythritol, pentanol, cyclohexanehexol and the like are subjected to a reaction through bis (trichloromethyl) carbonate, trichloromethyl chloroformate and carbonyl chloride to generate chloroformate, the cross-linking agents are subjected to a reaction with deprotected alpha, beta and gamma-cyclodextrin, and the cross-linking agents are subjected to a cross-linking reaction to obtain the beta-cyclodextrin. According to the method, carbonate-crosslinked cyclodextrin nano-hydrogel with different particle sizes is formed, and release of drugs loaded by the crosslinked cyclodextrin nano-hydrogel is controlled through breakage of carbonate bonds under an acidic condition. According to the acid-sensitive cross-linked cyclodextrin nano-hydrogel drug delivery system prepared by the method, the particle size can be effectively controlled by controlling the cross-linking quantity of cyclodextrin through the cross-linking agent, and the drug delivery system is uniform in size distribution, stable in a physiological environment, simple in synthesis route, low in cost and suitable for large-scale production.

column13: The invention is applicable to the technical field of biological materials, provides a preparation method and application of a negatively charged anti-HPV (human papillomavirus) biological protein gel dressing, and discloses the preparation method of the negatively charged anti-HPV biological protein gel dressing and the application of the negatively charged biological protein gel dressing. The bioprotein with negative charges has good histocompatibility and biological activity; the bioprotein-carbomer hydrogel with negative charges can provide a hydrophobic environment or surface groups for interaction of drugs, so that efficient loading of the drugs is realized, the hydrogel has acid-base sensitivity, controlled release of the drugs can be performed, and the method is simple and easy to implement; the phase transformation pH value of the bioprotein-carbomer hydrogel with negative charges reaches the critical pH value through the alkaline solution to form the hydrogel, and the sol is conveniently recovered when the pH value is lower than the critical pH value through the acidic solution, so that the damage caused by dressing replacement can be reduced.

column12: Controlled-release microspheres wrapping human mesenchymal stem cells as well as preparation method and preservation method of controlled-release microspheres
column13: The invention provides controlled-release microspheres wrapping human mesenchymal stem cells as well as a preparation method and a preservation method of the controlled-release microspheres, and belongs to the technical field of stem cells, biological materials and pharmaceutical preparations. According to the preparation method, stem cell-alginate microspheres are prepared based on an electrostatic spraying method, then the stem cell-alginate microspheres are stacked and self-assembled layer by layer to obtain controlled release microspheres coated with human mesenchymal stem cells, the controlled release microspheres are prepared according to the principle that an alginate solution is rapidly crosslinked under mild physiological conditions to form hydrogel, chitosan-alginate lyase is coated on the surface, and the hydrogel is coated with chitosan-alginate lyase. A physical barrier can be provided for the stem cells, so that the stem cells are prevented from being influenced by local severe environment in vivo; in addition, the invention also provides a stem cell preparation preserving fluid, the stem cell preparation preserving fluid significantly improves the survival rate of cells in vivo, and detection indexes such as the cell viability, the surface specific antigen and the multidirectional differentiation ability of stem cells meet the activity requirements of FDA on cell transplantation.

column12: Controlled release microsphere and anti-aging application thereof
column13: The invention relates to a controlled release microsphere and an anti-aging application thereof. Specifically, the invention provides a controlled release microsphere, the controlled release microsphere comprises calcium alginate hydrogel, bacillus subtilis capable of expressing and secreting basic fibroblast growth factor (bFGF) and one or more anti-aging compounds, and the calcium alginate hydrogel is used for encapsulating the bacillus subtilis and the anti-aging compounds. The invention also provides a method for preparing the controlled release microsphere and a method for preventing or treating senescence or senescence-related diseases or symptoms by using the controlled release microsphere. The anti-aging active compounds, such as NMN and hbFGF, delivered by the controlled release microspheres of the present invention have better in vivo absorption capacity and bioavailability.

column12: Paclitaxel nanoemulsion inhalation preparation for targeted therapy of lung cancer and preparation method of paclitaxel nanoemulsion inhalation preparation
column13: The invention provides a preparation method of a paclitaxel nano preparation, which is characterized in that the plasma half-life period of paclitaxel is prolonged, and the toxicity of paclitaxel is reduced. The paclitaxel nano preparation is composed of paclitaxel, poloxamer, chitosan, a polylactic acid-glycolic acid copolymer, an emulsifier and other pharmaceutic adjuvants. The inner water phase is composed of a poloxamer aqueous solution, after the poloxamer aqueous solution and the paclitaxel-containing PLGA organic phase form primary emulsion, the primary emulsion is injected into a chitosan-containing PVA solution to form multiple emulsion, stirring is performed at the room temperature to volatilize an organic solvent, insoluble substances are removed through centrifugation, and washing and freeze drying are performed to obtain the paclitaxel-containing poloxamer hydrogel. According to the preparation method of the paclitaxel nano preparation, paclitaxel is dissolved in an organic phase containing PLGA, a hydrophobic environment is provided, the stability of paclitaxel is improved, the half-life period of plasma is prolonged, and the dosage of paclitaxel is reduced. The invention provides a targeted drug delivery inhalation preparation for treating lung cancer, which prolongs the half-life period of the drug and reduces the continuous damage of high-dose drugs to human bodies.

column12: Hydrogel coating for Eustachian tube balloon dilatation catheter and preparation method thereof
column13: The invention discloses a hydrogel coating for an Eustachian tube balloon dilatation catheter and a preparation method of the hydrogel coating, and belongs to the technical field of medical equipment. column12: Injectable photo-crosslinking acellular matrix composite hydrogel as well as preparation method and application thereof
column13: The invention discloses injectable and photo-crosslinked acellular matrix composite hydrogel as well as a preparation method and application thereof. The preparation method comprises the following steps: (1) mixing acellular matrix powder with an acidic pepsin solution, stirring, and removing undigested matrix particles to obtain an acellular matrix pre-gelatinizing solution; (2) carrying out precooling treatment on the decellularized matrix pregelatinizing solution, adding an alkaline solution, and adjusting the pH value to 7.0-7.4; and (3) dissolving polyethylene glycol diacrylate and a photoinitiator in a pre-cooled buffer solution, uniformly stirring with the pre-gelatinizing solution in the step (2) at 0-8 DEG C, and carrying out photo-crosslinking curing to obtain the acellular matrix composite hydrogel. The preparation method is simple and high in operability, and the prepared composite hydrogel is high in mechanical strength, long in degradation time and good in biocompatibility; the hydrogel can be used for loading growth factors, and illumination crosslinking is performed after the hydrogel is injected into a living body, so that sustainable release of the growth factors in the living body is realized, and tissue repair and regeneration are promoted.

Local chemical immunotherapy is carried out by mixing a drug for inducing death of immunogen cells, a two-dimensional nano material for photo-thermal controlled slow release, an immunologic adjuvant and hydrogel. An antibody that triggers a non-specific immune response may be contained in the mixture for topical injection, or may be used by conventional intravenous injection. After the mixture is injected into the tumor, the hydrogel will locally retain and continuously controllably release the therapeutic drug to reduce systemic toxicity. With the help of an immunologic adjuvant, chemotherapy-induced immune cell death triggers a specific immune response of a tumor, and an antibody further amplifies the immune response, thereby eliciting an effective systemic anti-tumor immune response in the aspects of destroying local tumors, eliminating metastasis and inhibiting cancer recurrence.

column12: SHAPE MEMORY POLYMER HYDROGELS FOR WOUND HEALING
column13: A shape memory polymer hydrogel that is biodegradable, includes antimicrobial agents, and has a tunable drug delivery is used for wound healing internally and externally. The chemistry can be tuned to provide desired transition temperatures for delivery (e.g. below 37° C.) and desired pore sizes for healing (e.g. 250-500 μm).

column12: System for delivery of FK506 for enhancing nerve regeneration
column13: The present disclosure provides delivery systems for delivering FK506 locally to damaged nerve sites. Particulate FK506 incorporated into a fibrin gel, with the amount of FK506 sufficient to give an FK506 release rate over at least 14 days of at least 5 micrograms per milliliter of the treated tissue per day has been shown to remarkably improve axon regeneration. The delivery systems include particulate FK506 having sizes between about 500 microns to about 1 millimeter encapsulated in a fibrin matrix, powdered FK506 encapsulated within electrospun films, powdered FK506 encapsulated within a cellulose matrix, and a flexible film of small intestinal submucosa having a plurality of solid islands located on one side thereof, with each island containing a preselected amount of FK506 and a polyester. The local application of FK506 via the local delivery system disclosed herein results in excellent nerve regeneration while preventing the toxicity of systemic FK506 that has prevented clinicians from using FK506 routinely for treating severe cases of peripheral nerve injuries. In addition to being used for treatment of damaged nerve sites, the present systems may be applied to other types of injuries, including but not limited to spinal cord Injuries, stroke, vascularized composite allotransplantation (VCA) and local applications during solid organ transplants.

column12: Bi-crosslinking self-healing hydrogel and preparation method thereof
column13: The invention relates to double-crosslinking self-healing hydrogel and a preparation method thereof. According to the hydrogel, ethylene glycol chitosan and methyl cellulose serve as raw materials, hexanoylated ethylene glycol chitosan (HGC) is generated through the reaction of ethylene glycol chitosan and hexanoic anhydride, methyl cellulose is oxidized through sodium periodate to obtain oxidized methyl cellulose (DAMC), then a dynamic imine bond is formed through the Schiff base reaction of the aldehyde group of the DAMC and the amino group on the HGC, and the dynamic imine bond is formed through the Schiff base reaction of the aldehyde group of the DAMC and the amino group on the HGC. And the HGC-DAMC hydrogel is prepared and obtained. The method is mild in reaction condition, simple and safe to operate and easier to accept by researchers. The prepared HGC-DAMC hydrogel has good self-healing capability, solves the problem that the structure of the traditional hydrogel is easy to damage in the use process, can realize self-healing under the condition of no external stimulation, and reduces the use of chemical cross-linking agents. The HGC-DAMC hydrogel has potential application value in the fields of injectable drug sustained-release carriers and the like.

column12: Drug delivery from hydrogels
column13: Drug delivery involving hydrogels as used for various medical conditions, and includes hydrogels formed in an eye with extended drug release times. An embodiment of the invention is a method of delivering a therapeutic agent to a tissue comprising forming a hydrogel in situ in an eye with a therapeutic agent dispersed in the hydrogel, the agent having a low solubility in water. The agent may be essentially insoluble in water. The hydrogel may be made so that 50% to 100% w/w of the agent is released when the hydrogel is from 100% to 50% persistent, with the persistence being a measure of the dry weight of the hydrogel relative to an initial dry weight of the hydrogel.

column12: Antibacterial, adhesive and self-healing hydrogel as well as preparation method and application thereof
column13: The invention relates to antibacterial, adhesive and self-healing hydrogel as well as a preparation method and application thereof. The antibacterial, adhesive and self-healing hydrogel comprises a matrix material and mesoporous polydopamine nanoparticles loaded in the matrix material, the base material comprises gelatin, aldehyde-terminated polyethylene glycol, and chitosan modified by quaternary ammonium salt and catechol. Wherein quaternary ammonium salt and catechol are modified in a hydrogel network in situ, so that the hydrogel is endowed with antibacterial activity; the aldehyde group and amino in chitosan or gelatin can form a dynamic bond (Schiff base) to endow the hydrogel with self-healing performance; the mesoporous polydopamine nanoparticles loaded in the matrix material can be used as nano cross-linking points of the hydrogel to form abundant hydrogen bonds, ionic bonds and pi-pi bonds with the hydrogel matrix, so that the mechanical property, brittle fracture resistance, adhesion and self-healing property of the hydrogel are further improved; as the mesoporous polydopamine nanoparticles can be used as a drug carrier and have a photothermal conversion effect, the release of the drug can be regulated and controlled by controlling the intensity of near-infrared light, so that the controllable release of the drug is realized.

column12: CATIONIC CONTACT LENS
column13: A cationic contact lens is described as well as methods of manufacturing the same. The cationic contact lens includes a polymeric lens body that is the reaction product of a polymerizable composition that includes at least one siloxane, at least one nonionic hydrophilic monomer and at least one acyclic tertiary amine monomer. The cationic contact lens can be an unworn sterile silicone hydrogel contact lens. The contact lens is capable of substantially linear release of a releasable anionic agent and the at least one acyclic tertiary amine monomer facilitates uptake and/or sustained release of the releasable anionic agent by the polymeric lens body. The contact lens can be present in a sealed contact lens package. The sealed contact lens package can include at least a) a base member having a cavity; b) a contact lens packaging solution in the cavity; c) a unworn sterile contact lens immersed in the contact lens packaging solution in the cavity with the releasable anionic agent present; and d) a cover that forms a liquid-tight seal with the base member.

column12: Xylan-based dual network nanocomposite hydrogel, preparation method thereof and use therefor
column13: This invention belongs to the technical field of composite materials, and discloses a xylan-based dual network nanocomposite hydrogel, preparation method thereof and use therefor. The method comprises (1) adding graphite oxide powder into deionized water, ultrasonically dispersing to obtain a GO aqueous dispersion; (2) adding xylan into deionized water, heating and stirring to obtain a xylan solution; (3) adding a water-soluble calcium salt, a reaction monomer and the xylan solution into the GO aqueous dispersion, and stirring and dispersing uniformly under an ice-bath condition, then adding an initiator, a crosslinking agent and an accelerator, stirring and mixing uniformly to obtain a mixed solution; and 4) drying and reacting the mixed solution (in the step (3) to obtain a xylan-based dual network nanocomposite hydrogel. The composite hydrogel obtained by this invention has high mechanical property, is biodegradable and biocompatible, and can be used in the field of biomedicine, such as tissue engineering, drug sustained release, cell culture scaffold and cartilage tissue, etc.

column12: EVALUATION OF PCL/PEG COMPOSITES FOR RESTORATIVE APPLICATIONS WITHIN THE TRACHEA
column13: Prolonged endotracheal intubation, frequently with large diameter endotracheal tubes (ETTs), puts adults at risk of long-term breathing, voice, and swallowing complications and results in acute laryngeal injury, including tracheal or posterior glottic stenosis. Currently, treatment options for prevention of posterior glottic, subglottic, or tracheal stenosis are limited to 5 minimizing the duration of intubation and utilizing the smallest endotracheal tube possible, severely limiting clinical care. In this study, we develop a novel composite coating based on electrospun polycaprolactone (PCL) fibers embedded in a four-arm polyethylene glycol acrylate matrix (4APEGA) to transform the endotracheal tube from a functional, mechanical device to a dual-purpose device capable of delivering therapeutics to the local microenvironment. Further, the 10 composite coating system (PCL-4APEGA) is capable of controlled delivery of anti-inflammatory steroids, demonstrated through the controlled release of dexamethasone over a sustained period and additional therapeutic delivery of targeted smad3 silencing siRNA in the short term to address immediate reduction in pro-fibrotic transforming growth factor beta signaling in the upper airway as well as suppressing long-term sequelae from prolonged intubation. The results of this study 15 demonstrated that the increase in surface lubrication of the ETT's surface and the reduction of the surface stiffness due to the hydrogel-based composite had a direct impact on maintaining epithelial mucus production, while reducing epithelial adhesion, and epithelial layer abrasion.

column12: Preparation method of injectable in-situ cross-linked hydrophobic drug sustained-release hydrogel
column13: The invention discloses a preparation method of injectable in-situ cross-linked hydrophobic drug sustained-release hydrogel, which comprises the following steps: (1) preparing a hydrophobic drug solution by using an organic solvent, and slowly dripping the hydrophobic drug solution into continuously stirred pure water to prepare hydrophobic drug dispersed particles; (2) stirring and mixing the hydrophobic drug dispersed particles and a dopamine solution to prepare drug-coated polydopamine nano microspheres; and (3) preparing the drug-coated polydopamine nano-microspheres into a suspension with deionized water, and mixing the suspension with sulfydryl functionalized hyaluronic acid to prepare the hydrogel. The prepared hydrogel is a minimally invasive hydrophobic drug in-vivo delivery system, combines good biocompatibility of hyaluronic acid and dopamine, has the advantages of rapid in-situ crosslinking, slow degradation speed and the like of a crosslinking system, and achieves the effect of long-term in-situ slow release of drugs.

column12: Sustained Release Hydrogel Formulation Containing Levofloxacin Hemihydrate for Ocular Drug Delivery
column13: Abstract: A major problem in ocular therapeutics is the attainment of an optimal drug concentration at the site of action. To achieve effective ophthalmic therapy, an adequate amount of active ingredient must be delivered and maintained within the eye. The most frequently used dosage forms i.e., eye solution, eye ointments, eye gels and eye suspensions are compromised in their effectiveness by several limitations leading to poor ocular bioavailability' Ophthalmic use of viscosity enhancing agents, penetration enhancers, cyclodextrins, prodrug approaches, and ocular inserts and the ready existing drug carrier systems. The purpose of this research was to develop a Stimuli sensitive mainly temperature sensitive ophthalmic drug delivery system of Levofloxacin hemihydrate, a Fluoroquinolone antibiotic. Poloxamer 407 as thermo responsive gelling agent, PEG 6000 or PEG 400 as viscolyzer and Carbopol 940 or PVA as mucoadhesive agent were employed for the formation of temperature sensitive hydrogels. The promising temperature sensitive formulations Fl, F2 and F3 were evaluated for pH, drug content, in vitro gelation, in vitro viscosity of liquid formulation, in vitro drug release, in-vitro viscosity of gelled formulations, sterility, Pyrogen testing, ocular irritation, and stability. Percent drug content of 97.25%, 98.1% and 98.35%; viscosity of 32.523Pa-s, 34.448 Pa-s, and 38.234 Pa-s at 10 rpm and cumulative percent release of 85.52%, 81.11% and 74.72 % was observed formulations F1, F2 and F3 respectively. The developed formulations were therapeutically efficacious, stable, and non-irritant and provided sustained release of the drug over a period of 8 hour.

column12: INJECTABLE HYDROGEL FOR TREATING CENTRAL NERVOUS INJURY AND PREPARATION METHOD THEREFOR
column13: An in-situ injectable hydrogel for treating central nervous injury and a preparation method therefor. The hydrogel is formed by means of performing click chemical coupling on arginine-glycine-aspartic acid-modified multi-arm polyethylene glycol-X and multi-arm polyethylene glycol-Y by means of functional groups, and the hydrogel is coated with nano/micro particles and growth factors of sustained-release immunomodulatory and/or antioxidant drugs loaded thereon by means of chemical coupling reaction. The injectable hydrogel delivers precise and sustained local release of immunomodulatory and/or antioxidant drugs and growth factors at the site of an injury, so that the formation of a cystic cavity after spinal cord injury is prevented, secondary injury caused by neuroinflammation is alleviated, residual spinal cord nerve tissues and axons are protected, and the formation of glial scar tissues is reduced. The hydrogel provides a permeable extracellular matrix environment for the regeneration of body nerve axons, thereby promoting the recovery of electrophysiological and motor functions, and can be used for the repair of injuries to soft tissues such as the spinal cord.

column12: Preparation method of natural polymer organic nano-composite injectable double-network hydrogel capable of being subjected to secondary mechanical enhancement
column13: The invention belongs to the field of material science, the field of nano materials and the field of biomedical engineering, and particularly relates to a preparation method of natural polymer organic nano composite injectable double-network hydrogel capable of being subjected to secondary mechanical enhancement. The hydrogel material is assembled by natural organic polymer nanoparticles to form a hydrogel network; the size of the organic nanoparticles is 10 nm to 20 [mu] m; according to the method, non-covalent acting forces such as electrostatic assembly, hydrogen-bond interaction and hydrophobic interaction among organic nano-particles are utilized for self-assembly to form a gel network, the gel scaffold is obtained through additive manufacturing, and the gel scaffold has excellent printing performance and high mechanical strength. The hydrogel network has microcosmic pores, the pore size is 0.1-100 [mu] m, and high-strength hydrogel can be further formed through covalent cross-linking of a polyvinyl alcohol network to achieve the purpose that the mechanical performance is matched with a target tissue. The scaffold can be applied to the field of biomedicine as a bone repair scaffold, a cartilage repair scaffold and a drug sustained-release carrier.

column12: Liver targeting small nucleic acid drug sustained-release delivery system and application thereof
column13: The invention belongs to the technical field of biology, and particularly relates to a liver-targeted small nucleic acid drug sustained-release delivery system and application thereof. The invention aims to solve the technical problems of poor in-vivo uptake rate and stability of a GalNAc-small nucleic acid drug. The technical means for solving the technical problem is to provide the liver targeting small nucleic acid drug slow-release delivery system. The polypeptide DP7-C modified by cholesterol can be used for efficiently delivering a GalNAc-small nucleic acid drug to liver cells. According to the invention, the DP7-C/GalNAc-small nucleic acid drug compound is dispersed in the hydrogel to form a new delivery system, so that the stability of the GalNAc-small nucleic acid drug can be more effectively maintained, a long-acting slow-release effect is achieved, and the hydrogel has a very good practical application effect in vivo. According to the technical scheme, preparation is convenient, low toxicity and safety are achieved, the preparation period is short, and compared with an existing delivery system, the transfection efficiency is higher, the cytotoxicity is lower, the long-acting slow-release effect is better, and the good application prospect is achieved.

column12: Preparation method of pollen antigen presenting cluster and application of pollen antigen presenting cluster in immune cell amplification
column13: The invention provides a preparation method of a pollen antigen presenting cluster. The preparation method comprises the following steps: step 1, preparing pollen cavity microspheres with spiny structures; 2, the pollen cavity microspheres prepared in the step 1 are soaked in a hydrogel solution containing medicine, cavities of the pollen cavity microspheres are filled with hydrogel in a vacuum decompression mode, then the hydrogel is cured through ultraviolet irradiation, cell factors are locked, and pollen hydrogel hybrid microspheres are obtained; and step 3, soaking the pollen hydrogel hybrid microspheres prepared in the step 2 in a cross-linking solution containing an activated antibody, and modifying the activated antibody on the surfaces of the pollen hydrogel hybrid microspheres by a chemical grafting method to obtain the pollen antigen presenting cluster. The pollen antigen presenting cluster constructed by the invention simulates dendritic cells through drug loading and temperature driving and responds to environmental signals, can load drugs and realize controllable release, and has the capability of being applied to in-vitro activation and amplification of T cells.

column12: Methods of treating HIV-1 infection utilizing broadly neutralizing human immunodeficiency virus type 1 (HIV-1) GP120-specific monoclonal antibodies
column13: The invention provides a method for obtaining a broadly neutralizing antibody (bNab), including screening memory B cell cultures from a donor PBMC sample for neutralization activity against a plurality of HIV-1 species, cloning a memory B cell that exhibits broad neutralization activity; and rescuing a monoclonal antibody from that memory B cell culture. The resultant monoclonal antibodies may be characterized by their ability to selectively bind epitopes from the Env proteins in native or monomeric form, as well as to inhibit infection of HIV-1 species from a plurality of clades. Compositions containing human monoclonal anti-HIV antibodies used for prophylaxis, diagnosis and treatment of HIV infection are provided. Methods for generating such antibodies by immunization using epitopes from conserved regions within the variable loops of gp120 are provided. column12: Synchronous radiotherapy and chemotherapy intratumor drug delivery precise treatment device guided by endoscope real-time image
column13: The invention discloses a synchronous radiotherapy and chemotherapy intratumor drug delivery precise treatment device guided by an endoscope real-time image. Corresponding drugs can comprise solutions of targeting, radiotherapy, immunization and other clinical drugs, atomized liquid, nanoparticles for radiotherapy sensitization and imaging radiography, sustained-release self-degradable hydrogel and other polymorphic delivery, high-energy X-rays are combined for precise radiotherapy, the tumor local control rate and the patient survival rate can be increased, and the application has good application prospects. column12: Preparation method of self-floating MP/H microspheres wrapping water-insoluble solid powder

column13: The invention discloses a nadolol sustained-release injection, which is prepared from the following components in percentage by weight: 0.8 to 1.5 percent of nadolol liposome, 0.01 to 0.05 percent of polycarbophil, 0.05 to 0.2 percent of surfactant, 1.8 to 2.5 percent of hydrogel material and the balance of deionized water. The hydrogel material is composed of alginic acid and inorganic salts thereof, and polyacrylamide or derivatives thereof. The nadolol nano sustained-release particle with a double-layer structure is formed by the ethylene-vinyl acetate copolymer and the oleic acid, and the sustained-release effect is good after local subcutaneous injection.

column12: Tetrahydrocurcumin compound-GelMA hydrogel as well as preparation method and application thereof
column13: The invention provides tetrahydrocurcumin compound-GelMA hydrogel, and belongs to the technical field of medicine polymer synthesis. According to the invention, tetrahydrocurcumin is loaded on GelMA hydrogel to obtain the tetrahydrocurcumin-GelMA hydrogel with a drug sustained release effect, and the GelMA hydrogel is safe and non-toxic. The result of the embodiment shows that the tetrahydrocurcumin-GelMA hydrogel provided by the invention can be continuously released for more than 70 hours in a normal physiological environment and a simulated focus site environment.

column12: Injectable temperature-sensitive drug sustained-release carrier hydrogel and preparation method thereof
column13: The invention discloses a preparation method of injectable temperature-sensitive drug sustained-release carrier hydrogel. The preparation method comprises the following steps: (1) oxidizing primary alcohol groups at two ends of Pluronic to obtain Pluronic (F127-CHO) with an aldehyde group at the end group; (2) adding F127-CHO into ultrapure water, and stirring in an ice-water bath to prepare an F127-CHO solution; (3) adding carboxymethyl chitosan into ultrapure water, stirring and dissolving to prepare a carboxymethyl chitosan solution; and (4) mixing the F127-CHO solution and the carboxymethyl chitosan solution with the same volume, stirring at low temperature and low speed for 10-30 minutes, and reacting at 37 DEG C for 12 hours to obtain the temperature-sensitive hydrogel. The preparation method disclosed by the invention is simple, mild in reaction condition and low in raw material cost. The hydrogel prepared by the invention has excellent injectable, temperature-sensitive and self-healing properties, and can form gel in situ at a focus as a drug sustained-release carrier, so that the release period, the utilization rate and the treatment effect of the drug are improved.

column12: NANOLIPOGEL VEHICLES FOR CONTROLLED DELIVERY OF DIFFERENT PHARMACEUTICAL AGENTS
column13: A “nanolipogel” is a delivery vehicle including one or more lipid layer surrounding a hydrogel core, which may include an absorbent such as a cyclodextrin or ion-exchange resin. Nanolipogels can be constructed so as to incorporate a variety of different chemical entities that can subsequently be released in a controlled fashion. These different incorporated chemical entities can differ dramatically with respect to size and composition. Nanolipogels have been constructed to contain co-encapsulated proteins as well as small hydrophobic drugs within the interior of the lipid bilayer. Agents incorporated within nanolipogels can be released into the milieu in a controlled fashion, for example, nanolipogels provide a means of achieving simultaneous sustained release of agents that differ widely in chemical composition and molecular weight. Additionally, nanolipogels can favorably modulate biodistribution.

column12: Topical solubilized ivermectin for inflammatory skin conditions
column13: A topical solubilized ivermectin pharmaceutical composition for the treatment and/or prevention of inflammatory skin conditions is disclosed herein. The topical solubilized ivermectin pharmaceutical composition comprises an ivermectin and a cyclodextrin. Particularly, ivermectin is combined with cyclodextrin to form an ivermectin-cyclodextrin complex solubilized in a Tween80-water solution up to a 30% by weight of solution. The present invention features a formulation of Ivermectin-cyclodextrin complex solubilized in a Tween80-water solution incorporated into lotion or cream or gel base that is highly effective in the treatment inflammatory skin conditions at a concentration of, in some embodiments, 0.125% to 5% ivermectin by weight.

column12: Pharmaceutical composition for tumor immunotherapy based on vitamin C hydrogel
column13: The invention discloses a pharmaceutical composition for tumor immunotherapy based on vitamin C hydrogel, and relates to the technical field of immune drugs. According to the pharmaceutical composition for tumor immunotherapy, a vitamin C hydrogel is used for delivering immunoregulation drugs for the first time, so that high-concentration enrichment and sustainable release are achieved; the vitamin C hydrogel entraps a plurality of immunomodulatory drugs, so that the synergism of the functions of the vitamin C hydrogel and the immunomodulatory drugs can be realized, and the curative effect of the vitamin C hydrogel is obviously superior to that of single-component VitC hydrogel and immunomodulatory drugs, wherein the VitC can promote the maturation of DCs and increase the in-tumor infiltration of NK cells and tumor killing T cells, and the loaded immunomodulatory drug can further weaken the immunosuppressed tumor microenvironment and increase the in-tumor infiltration of the T cells; and the pharmaceutical composition of the vitamin C hydrogel for tumor immunotherapy can efficiently inhibit growth and metastasis of primary tumors and distal tumors.
