column12: Preparation method and application of cartilage repair nanogel composite system
column13: The invention relates to the technical field of cartilage repair, and discloses a preparation method and application of a cartilage repair nanogel composite system. The preparation method comprises the steps of preparing KPP nanoparticles, synthesizing injectable PLEL hydrogel and preparing a KPP@PLEL composite system. The invention further discloses a KPP@PLEL composite system with double attributes of drug sustained release and cartilage permeation and application of the KPP@PLEL composite system. According to the invention, the researched and developed KPP@PLEL composite system has double attributes of drug sustained release and cartilage permeation, can effectively permeate dense cartilage tissues, continuously delivers drugs to the interior of the cartilage and a delivery system of target cells MSCs, can effectively activate endogenous repair of the cartilage and generates synergistic anti-inflammatory and anti-catabolism effects; and the KPP@PLEL composite system can be used for improving the curative effect of the acting medicine and reducing the side effects of the whole body, promoting further clinical development and application of KGN, and has important significance on cartilage injury repair research and articular cavity local medicine development.

column12: Chitosan materials from carbonic acid solution
column13: The present invention comprises chitosan materials and methods of using carbonic acid for aqueous solubilization of neutralized or pre-treated chitosan gels and provides, among other things, substantially acid salt free composition native final forms without requiring subsequent acid salt elution. The invention includes chitosan-based solid and semi-solid material forms, optionally reinforced with chitosan fibers, such as powders, fibers, films, matrices, sponges, implants, scaffolds, fillers, and hydrogels. Native final forms are produced from chitosan powder solubilized in an aqueous acidic solution, processed to form a high pH hydrated chitosan gel precipitate material that is then neutralized by water washing and re-solubilized substantially to chitosan solution using carbonic acid. Chitosan materials can be mixed in solution with one or more of other hydrophilic polymers to create compositional heterogeneity and pharmaceutical agents to achieve controlled release of the agent(s) from the final forms at the site of application.

column12: Composition for inhibiting fungi as well as preparation method and application thereof
column13: The invention discloses a composition for inhibiting fungi as well as a preparation method thereof, belongs to the field of pharmaceutics, and particularly relates to a preparation method and application of a composition hydrogel preparation containing L-selenium methyl selenocysteine. The L-selenium methyl selenocysteine has an obvious inhibition effect on fungi, such as a yeast state and a hypha state of candida albicans, and can effectively intervene and treat diseases infected by the fungi. The L-selenium methyl selenocysteine disclosed by the invention can be combined with common antifungal drugs and adrenocortical hormone drugs to achieve a better treatment effect. The hydrogel is an excellent drug carrier, has good biocompatibility and retention performance, and can effectively prolong the drug action time and enhance the drug effect. The L-selenium methyl selenocysteine disclosed by the invention is disclosed as a natural bioactive amino acid for inhibiting fungi for the first time, and is expected to provide a new treatment scheme for clinical fungal infection diseases and recurrent fungal diseases.

column12: Hyaluronic acid and biodegradable polymer modified material and preparation method thereof
column13: The invention discloses a hyaluronic acid and biodegradable polymer modified material and a preparation method thereof, and belongs to the technical field of polymer material modification. The preparation method comprises the steps: performing modification treatment on hyaluronic acid by using starch to obtain modified hyaluronic acid, enabling sulfydryl and carboxyl in the modified hyaluronic acid to be subjected to cross-linking reaction with groups in a biodegradable material under the action of a curing agent, pre-radiating a cross-linking product under an aerobic condition, and heating and drying to obtain the hyaluronic acid and biodegradable polymer modified material. The raw materials such as starch, hyaluronic acid and biodegradable materials in the preparation process are safe and non-toxic and do not cause harm to human bodies, the preparation process is simple, the yield is high, the degradation rate is high, the biocompatibility is good, and the hydrogel can be applied to the medical field to serve as a drug carrier to achieve the purpose of rapid drug release.

column12: Acrylic acid-sodium acrylate-sulfonic acid inner salt copolymerization cross-linked product and preparation method and application thereof
column13: The invention relates to the technical field of hydrogel, in particular to an acrylic acid-sodium acrylate-sulfonic acid inner salt copolymerization cross-linked product and a preparation method and application thereof. The preparation method comprises the steps: adding acrylic acid, sodium hydroxide and sulfonic acid inner salt which are accurately weighed into a dry reactor and dissolving with a certain amount of distilled water; uniformly stirring, adding a cross-linking agent and an initiator, carrying out nitrogen sealing and constant-temperature reaction until the system is free of flowability to obtain a crude product, soaking and washing with acetone, carrying out suction filtration, drying, crushing and sieving to obtain a purified product; the product uses cheap and easily available acrylic acid as a main raw material and is supplemented with a proper proportion of salt-sensitive-resistant functional monomer inner sulfonate to generate a synergistic effect, and meanwhile, the product has the advantages of low cost and high salt resistance, can be applied to the field of hydrogel, as a water-absorbent resin, the product can be applied to salt environments such as agriculture and forestry water-retaining agents, drug sustained-release carriers, chemical fertilizer controlled-release, heavy metal ion adsorption in high-salt-content wastewater and the like, and has wide application prospects.

column12: Tough chitosan hydrogel as well as preparation method and application thereof
column13: The invention discloses tough chitosan hydrogel as well as a preparation method and application thereof. Chitosan dissolution and gelation characteristics are associated, and a stable covalent bond cross-linked network is formed by a chitosan solution by adopting an ultraviolet light cross-linking method. According to the method, acrylic acid or methacrylic acid containing unsaturated double bonds is selected as a solvent of chitosan, a reaction environment is provided for a chitosan-grafted acrylic acid photo-crosslinking agent, the obtained chitosan solution can be subjected to ultraviolet light crosslinking directly or after dialysis, and residual acrylic acid can be subjected to photopolymerization and be crosslinked with chitosan macromolecules to form tough chitosan hydrogel. According to the method, other natural polymers, functional additives or bioactive substances can be added in situ, the application field of the chitosan hydrogel is expanded, and the tough chitosan hydrogel can be applied to the fields of tissue scaffolds, sensors and drug sustained release.

column12: Encapsulation-free controlled protein release system
column13: The present disclosure provides a delivery system for controlled protein release without encapsulation. Identical, burst-free, extended release profiles for three different protein therapeutics were obtained with and without encapsulation in PLGA nanoparticles embedded within a hydrogel. Using both positively and negatively charged proteins, it was shown that short-range electrostatic interactions between the proteins and the PLGA nanoparticles are the underlying mechanism for controlled release. Moreover, tunable release was demonstrated by modifying nanoparticle concentration, nanoparticle size, or environmental pH. Additionally, the utility of this system was demonstrated in vivo for BDNF delivery in a rat model of stroke. These new insights obviate the need for encapsulation and offer promising, translatable strategies for more effective delivery of therapeutic biomolecules.

column13: A lacrimal drug delivery device includes a reservoir configured to hold a drug. The reservoir is moveable between a relaxed state and an expanded state. column12: Preparation method and application of self-assembled fibroin/polylactic acid block-like copolymer for drug delivery
column13: The invention discloses a preparation method of a self-assembled fibroin/polylactic acid block-like copolymer for drug delivery. The preparation method comprises the following steps: adding degummed fibroin fibers into ionic liquid to obtain a silk fibroin solution; adding polylactic acid into N, N-dimethylformamide to be dissolved to obtain a polylactic acid solution; mixing and stirring the silk fibroin solution and the polylactic acid solution to obtain a uniform silk fibroin/polylactic acid solution; and freeze-drying the fibroin/polylactic acid solution, immersing the fibroin/polylactic acid solution in ethanol, solidifying the fibroin/polylactic acid solution in a self-assembly manner to form a hydrogel state, and carrying out drying to obtain a fibroin/polylactic acid composite material with characteristics similar to those of typical block copolymers. The unique block-like structure provided by the invention can be applied to inclusion and delivery of drugs through hydrophobic or electrostatic interaction. The preparation method disclosed by the invention is green and environment-friendly, is simple and convenient to operate, can regulate and control the form, the structure, the physical property and the biological property of the fibroin/polylactic acid composite material, and provides a new method and thought for a green production process of the biological composite material.

column12: MICROPARTICLES FOR CONTROLLED RELEASE OF EXTRACELLULAR VESICLES AND METHODS FOR FABRICATING THE SAME
column13: A microparticle has a core comprising an aqueous phase including (i) a bioactive material comprising an extracellular vesicle (e.g., exosome) or a material derived from a cell and (ii) an optional hydrophilic stabilizing agent. An amphiphilic layer is disposed around the core and has a biodegradable amphiphilic block copolymer comprising hydrophilic and hydrophobic domains capable of self-assembly to define a core-shell structure. An aqueous shell layer may be temporarily disposed over the amphiphilic layer. The microparticle has a diameter of ≥ about 1 ≤ about 100 micrometers and releases the bioactive material for ≥ about 6 weeks when exposed to an aqueous medium. A tissue regeneration system can be implanted in a subject and may include a biocompatible tissue reconstruction material with the controlled release microparticles distributed therein. Methods of making controlled release microparticles are also provided, which form water-in-oil-in-water emulsions that are solidified.

column12: Sulfhydrylated chitosan and preparation method thereof
column13: The invention discloses sulfhydrylated chitosan and a preparation method thereof. The sulfhydrylated chitosan is chitosan jointly modified by hydroxybutyl and sulfydryl. The preparation method comprises the following steps: firstly, introducing hydroxybutyl on a chitosan molecular chain; secondly, in the sulfydryl part, free amino of hydroxybutyl chitosan and carboxyl of L-cysteine are subjected to condensation reaction to introduce sulfydryl; an aqueous solution of the sulfhydrylated chitosan is in a solution state at low temperature and can be subjected to flow injection, and when the temperature is raised to about 37 DEG C, hydrogel can be formed. Due to the introduction of sulfydryl, the oxidation resistance and tissue adhesion ability of the material are improved. The sulfhydrylated chitosan prepared by the method possibly has wide application prospects in the aspects of tissue engineering, drug delivery systems, cell culture, cosmetics and the like.

column12: THERAPEUTIC AGENT DELIVERY SYSTEMS AND METHODS OF FORMING AND USES THEREOF
column13: A novel therapeutic agent delivery system, methods of use and methods of formation thereof are presented. column12: Drug delivery system for preventing and treating hair loss, preparation method thereof and microneedle patch

column12: DYNAMICALLY CROSSLINKED INJECTABLE HYDROGELS WITH CHEMICALLY STABILIZED MULTILAMELLAR VESICLES
column13: An injectable hydrogel for drug delivery is provided having a first component of repeating protein domains, and a second component cross-linked with the first component. The protein domain in the repeating protein domains is a WW protein sequence interspersed with hydrophilic protein sequences (repeats ranges from 2 to 10). The second component is an inter-bilayer crosslinked multilamellar vesicle. The vesicle is capable of containing drug cargo and eluting the drug cargo. The vesicle is derived from a first lipid and a second lipid. The surface of the vesicle has tethers, which are cross-linked with protein domains of the first component. Control over elution rate of drug cargo is accomplished through stabilization of the vesicles. Gelation occurs in a simple and rapid mixing of the two components without the necessity of additional crosslinking stimuli. Tuning of elution rate is achieved while not losing injectability. Bioresorbable components are used.

column12: Nanolipogel vehicles for controlled delivery of different pharmaceutical agents
column13: A “nanolipogel” is a delivery vehicle including one or more lipid layer surrounding a hydrogel core, which may include an absorbent such as a cyclodextrin or ion-exchange resin. Nanolipogels can be constructed so as to incorporate a variety of different chemical entities that can subsequently be released in a controlled fashion. These different incorporated chemical entities can differ dramatically with respect to size and composition. Nanolipogels have been constructed to contain co-encapsulated proteins as well as small hydrophobic drugs within the interior of the lipid bilayer. Agents incorporated within nanolipogels can be released into the milieu in a controlled fashion, for example, nanolipogels provide a means of achieving simultaneous sustained release of agents that differ widely in chemical composition and molecular weight. Additionally, nanolipogels can favorably modulate biodistribution.

column12: Preparation of eel swimming bladder collagen-chitosan-composite sodium alginate hydrogel
column13: The invention provides a method for preparing an eel swimming bladder collagen-chitosan-composite sodium alginate hydrogel. The optimal conditions for extracting the collagen of the sea eel swimming bladder by the acid method through a single factor test and response surface optimization are as follows: the acetic acid concentration is 0.42 mol/L, the acidolysis time is 21h, and the liquid-material ratio is 58ml/g. The acid-soluble collagen separated from the sea eel swimming bladder can be used as a proper drug carrier system, is a good medicinal biological material, has a unique porous fiber structure, can be used for absorbing a large amount of water and supporting the skin surface, and has important effects on moisturizing and wrinkle resistance; the collagen can be used as a wound excipient or a drug carrier, has a healing promoting effect on a mouse skin wound, and has huge application potential in biomedical engineering and medicine.

column12: Double-sustained-release drug-loaded hydrogel dressing with semi-interpenetrating network entrapped double-layer microspheres as well as preparation method and application thereof
column13: The invention belongs to the technical field of medical dressings for repairing burn skin wounds, and provides a double-sustained-release drug-loaded hydrogel dressing with double-layer microspheres entrapped by a semi-interpenetrating network. Acrylic acid is used as a pH-sensitive monomer. The pH/temperature dual-sensitive intelligent hydrogel takes methacrylic acid 2-ethyl ester and oligomeric (ethylene glycol) methyl ether methacrylate as temperature-sensitive monomers, and an anti-inflammatory drug gentamicin sulfate is entrapped; the preparation method comprises the following steps: preparing a calcium alginate core sphere entrapped with bovine serum albumin through a high-voltage electrostatic instillation method, coating the surface of the core sphere with a chitosan shell layer entrapped with an antibacterial drug azithromycin to form a double-layer microsphere, and loading the double-layer microsphere into the hydrogel to obtain the hydrogel dressing capable of precisely and slowly releasing two drugs and one protein. According to the pH/temperature change of a wound surface microenvironment, the hydrogel can achieve accurate controlled release of drugs and improve the utilization rate of the drugs, and is a novel double-sustained-release drug-loaded hydrogel dressing with a semi-interpenetrating network combined double-layer microsphere structure and good comprehensive performance.

column12: DROPLET ENCAPSULATION OF A CELL AND CONTROLLED RELEASE PARTICLE
column13: Microfluidic devices and methods for co-encapsulation of a cell and a controlled release particle in one droplet are described herein. The devices and methods utilize laminar flow, high shear liquid-liquid interfaces, hydrodynamic vortices, and / or acoustic focusing to increase co-encapsulation efficiency. The precise variation of the droplet's microenvironment is enabled by the controlled release particle co-encapsulated with the single cell in each droplet. This capability, coupled with established detection methods, provides an important tool for precise, single cell analysis.

column12: No-load phase-inversion hydrogel microneedle, cobra sinensis neurotoxin phase-inversion hydrogel microneedle, and preparation method and application thereof

column13: The present invention relates to the formation of hydrogels from poly-amino acids designed from the β-aggregation-prone region of functional amyloidogenic proteins that self-assemble to form a three-dimensional nanofibril matrix. The present invention also explores the use of the designed hydrogels as cell and tissue adhesive biomaterial for tissue engineering applications. The present invention also relates to the application of functional amyloid hydrogel including but not limited to 3D tumoroid model for anticancer drug testing, optimization of drug dosage including drug-resistant tumors, repurposing of existing drugs, and patient-derived organoid. The present invention also describes the use of functional amyloid hydrogel as a depot for controlled and sustained release of therapeutics and biologic agents encapsulated within the same. The present invention also provides a moist highly water retentive material as reservoir of wound exudates thereby promotes healing.

column12: Spacer and manufacturing method thereof
column13: The present invention relates to a spacer using a hydrogel for treatment which assists in growth or bonding of living tissue after surgery or treatment of joints, muscles or ligaments, etc. According to the present invention, the spacer comprises: a support sheet made of a hydrogel material having a biodegradable and water-soluble polymer network structure; a sealing bag-type member surrounding the support sheet; and a pouch made of a biodegradable material. Since the support sheet is formed to dissolve in a body fluid faster than the pouch, stabilization and pain-reducing actions for a surgical site are maintained as it is and removal surgery for take the space out later is not required, thereby reducing cost and stress. In particular, the spacer includes a means for controlling a drug delivery rate to corresponding to different recovery rates or tissue regeneration rates depending on the type of an affected part or the age of a patient.

column12: Preparation method of temperature-sensitive hydrogel drug-loaded microspheres based on PNIPAAm modified nanocellulose
column13: The invention relates to a preparation method of temperature-sensitive hydrogel drug-loaded microspheres based on PNIPAAm modified nanocellulose, which comprises the following steps: (1) preparing a PCNCs suspension with a certain concentration, and using deionized water as a solvent; (2) preparing an SA solution by taking the suspension as a solvent, and stirring to form a mixed solution; and (3) uniformly stirring and degassing the mixed solution at room temperature, dripping the mixed solution into a CaCl2 solution at a fixed rate by using a micro-injection pump and a mechanical dripping method, stirring and cross-linking, washing residual CaCl2 on the surface of the hydrogel by using deionized water, and then drying or freeze-drying to obtain the PCNCs/SA hydrogel microspheres. The composite hydrogel prepared by the invention has remarkable temperature sensitivity, the swelling rate of the hydrogel under the condition that the temperature of a human body is 37 DEG C is increased, and the slow release effect of the hydrogel on drugs is more obvious; meanwhile, the sustained-release system is simple in preparation process, few in reagent, mild in production process and free of violent reaction, and technical support is provided for application of the novel temperature-sensitive hydrogel drug-loaded microspheres.

column12: Long-acting moisturizing sustained-release microsphere applied to make-up base, and preparation method of long-acting moisturizing sustained-release microsphere
column13: The invention relates to the technical field of cosmetics, and discloses a long-acting moisturizing sustained-release microsphere applied to a make-up base and a preparation method of the long-acting moisturizing sustained-release microsphere in order to solve the problems that an existing make-up base is poor in moisturizing and skin care persistence and a sustained-release condition of sustained-release microspheres in the make-up base is harsh. The sustained-release microsphere is internally filled with porous hydrogel and essence; the surface of the sustained-release microsphere is subjected to hole sealing by adopting a photolysis polymer, and the essence in the sustained-release microsphere is slowly released under the expansion and extrusion function of the porous hydrogel under the action of illumination; the essence comprises the following components in parts by weight: 2-5 parts of shea butter, 4-6parts of squalane, 10-15 parts of hyaluronic acid, 1-3 parts of vitamin E and 8-10 parts of n-butyl alcohol. The sustained-release microsphere is filled with the porous hydrogel which swells under an illumination condition, in addition, the porous hydrogel is full of the essence, a polymer which is cracked under the illumination condition is adopted for carrying out the hole sealing on the sustained-release microspheres, so that long-acting sustained release of the essence in the sustained-release microsphere is finally realized, and a relatively good moisturizing and skin-care effect is achieved.

column12: VEHICLES FOR CONTROLLED DELIVERY OF DIFFERENT PHARMACEUTICAL AGENTS
column13: To provide vehicles for controlled delivery of different pharmaceutical agents.SOLUTION: A "nanolipogel" is a delivery vehicle including one or more lipid layer surrounding a hydrogel core, which may include an absorbent such as a cyclodextrin or ion-exchange resin. Nanolipogels can be constructed so as to incorporate a variety of different chemical entities that can subsequently be released in a controlled fashion. These different incorporated chemical entities can differ dramatically with respect to size and composition. Nanolipogels have been constructed to contain co-encapsulated proteins as well as small hydrophobic drugs within the interior of the lipid bilayer. Agents incorporated within nanolipogels can be released into the milieu in a controlled fashion, for example, nanolipogels provide a means of achieving simultaneous sustained release of agents that differ widely in chemical composition and molecular weight. Additionally, nanolipogels can favorably modulate biodistribution.SELECTED DRAWING: None

column12: Preparation method of pH response type carboxymethyl chitosan/sodium alginate hydrogel ball

column12: Preparation method of novel chitosan-based dual-network hydrogel
column13: The invention discloses a preparation method of novel dual-network hydrogel. The method comprises the following steps: firstly, dissolving polyethylene glycol and maleimide acid in an organic solvent under the action of a dehydrating agent to prepare PEG-MI; then adding the PEG-M, chitosan, a hydrophilic monomer, a cross-linking agent and an photoinitiator into a beaker for dissolving, and conducting uniform stirring; and carrying out heating in a water bath for a period of time, forming a first network through a click reaction of amino and maleimide groups, performing irradiating under an ultraviolet lamp for a period of time, and forming a second network through photopolymerization, thereby obtaining the double-network hydrogel through a one-pot method. The preparation method provided by the invention is simple to operate, mild in conditions and controllable in process. column12: Three-dimensional reticular chitosan slow-release coating and preparation method thereof
column13: The invention discloses a preparation method of a chitosan-methacrylic anhydride/calcium carbonate (CSMA/CaCO3) hydrogel slow-release coating. The method is simple in preparation process, mild and controllable in condition, good in repeatability, low in production cost and suitable for industrial production. The prepared porous network hydrogel sustained-release coating has the advantages of good biocompatibility, easiness in degradation, high load rate and the like, and has wide application prospects in the fields of medicine and chemical industry.

column12: PH/temperature double-sensitive interpenetrating network hydrogel and preparation method thereof
column13: The invention discloses a method for preparing pH/temperature double-sensitive type interpenetrating network hydrogel through an anhydride-amino click reaction and free radical polymerization'one-pot method in a water phase. The method comprises the following steps: firstly, dissolving an amino-containing polymer, an anhydride-containing copolymer, a temperature-sensitive monomer, a cross-linking agent and an initiator into water, and adding a cross-linking agent and an initiator into the water; and performing an anhydride-amino click reaction to obtain a first polymer network (pH-sensitive network), and performing free polymerization to obtain a second network (temperature-sensitive network), so that the double-sensitive interpenetrating network hydrogel is obtained. The preparation process is simple, the conditions are mild, the reaction speed is high, and the obtained pH/temperature sensitive type interpenetrating network hydrogel combines the excellent performance of two networks and can be used in the fields of drug sustained release, tissue engineering, water treatment and the like.

column12: Application of broussonetia papyrifera roots and barks to preparation of medicine for treating atopic dermatitis
column13: The invention provides application of broussonetia papyrifera roots and barks to preparation of medicine for treating atopic dermatitis, and belongs to the technical field of medical medicine. The treatment period of atopic dermatitis is long, so that the hydrogel preparation can also improve the medication compliance of patients. Experimental results show that the drug-containing hydrogel preparation also has an obvious curative effect, the drug delivery is more compliant, the residence time of the drug in the skin of a sick mouse is prolonged, and the treatment effect is improved.

column12: Sustained-release hydrogel pressure-equalizing injection device
column13: The utility model discloses a slow-release hydrogel pressure-equalizing injection device which comprises an injection bin, an injection head is arranged at the front end of the injection bin, a support is arranged at the tail end of the injection bin, a pressure-equalizing mechanism is installed on the support and connected with a piston, and the piston is located on the inner side of the injection bin and tightly attached to the inner wall of the injection bin. The pressure equalizing mechanism comprises a driving motor, a lead screw, a sliding block, a supporting connecting rod and a fixing box, the driving motor is installed on the outer wall of the fixing box, the lead screw is installed on an output shaft of the driving motor through a coupler, one end of the lead screw is installed on the inner wall of the fixing box through a bearing, the lead screw is in threaded connection with the sliding block, and the supporting connecting rod is installed on the sliding block. The supporting connecting rod penetrates out of the fixing box and is connected to the piston. According to the slow-release hydrogel pressure-equalizing injection device disclosed by the utility model, uniform stress can be applied to the piston through the pressure-equalizing mechanism, so that the piston is easily and comprehensively pressed, and the hydrogel is uniformly pressed and has a good injection effect when being injected.

column12: Preparation method of double-stimulus synergistic response porous hydrogel modified acrylic bone cement
column13: The invention discloses a preparation method of double-stimulus synergistic response porous hydrogel modified acrylic bone cement. The preparation method specifically comprises the following steps: preparing pH-temperature sensitive hydrogel microspheres from acrylic acid, alpha-methacrylic acid and N-isopropylacrylamide as raw materials, preparing a porous hydrogel drug-loading stent by a method of etching a silica gel crystal template, and compounding the pH-temperature sensitive hydrogel microspheres and the porous hydrogel drug-loading stent to obtain double-stimulus synergistic response porous hydrogel modified acrylic bone cement. The double-stimulus response porous hydrogel microspheres form a three-dimensional porous high-drug-loading stent in acrylic bone cement. After being injected into a human body, the double-stimulus synergistic response porous hydrogel drug-loading expanded acrylic bone cement can release drugs according to abnormal changes of pH and temperature in a local microenvironment; when the microenvironment recovers normal drug release and stops drug release, long-acting controllable release can be maintained on the basis of on-demand release; and meanwhile, the porous structure provides conditions for promoting bone ingrowth. According to the bone cement prepared by the method in the invention, the problem of volume shrinkage of the acrylic bone cement is solved; and the clinical medical requirement of high-drug-loading long-acting controllable release is met.

column12: Compositions and layered structures formed therewith for regeneration of articular cartilage
column13: Compositions and implants for articular cartilage repair or regeneration are described. The compositions are hydrogel-based compositions that can incorporate signaling molecules for cartilage repair. The compositions include microcapsules having predetermined erosion profiles that are loaded with nanogels having predetermined sustained release profiles for signaling molecules conjugated to the nanogels. A plurality of compositions, each carrying different signaling molecules, can be layered to form a multi-layered implant, with each layer sequentially releasing the encapsulated signaling molecules over a predetermined period of time. The compositions can carry additional components to encourage tissue generation such as stem cells and extracellular matrix (ECM) components.

column12: Preparation method of injectable composite chitosan hydrogel for skin wound repair
column13: The invention relates to a preparation method of injectable composite chitosan hydrogel for skin wound repair. The hydrogel is mainly composed of modified chitosan, internal carrier cells and a bioactive factor. Firstly, a hydrogel precursor solution is prepared through emulsion polymerization, the main component of the hydrogel precursor solution is poly-N-isopropylacrylamide graft modified chitosan macromolecules, and the hydrogel can be in a solution state in a room temperature environment and can be rapidly gelated in a human body physiological temperature environment. Through mixing with a cell suspension and a bioactive factor, the obtained composite solution can realize in-situ rapid gelation at a skin wound and defect part, realizes in-situ fixation of cells, not only can provide good support for a wound part, but also can promote adhesion, proliferation and differentiation of internal cells of the wound part. The hydrogel is simple to prepare, convenient to use, quick in response and good in biocompatibility, and can be applied to a plurality of biomedical related fields such as tissue repair, drug controlled release, cell culture and cancer treatment.

column12: Preparation method of silk fibroin-gelatin bioactive composite hydrogel loaded with insulin particles
column13: The invention relates to the field of biomedical materials, and discloses a preparation method of silk fibroin-gelatin bioactive composite hydrogel loaded with insulin particles, which comprises the following steps: degumming silkworm cocoons, performing first-step dissolution on silk fibroin by using an FA/CaCl2 binary system, and performing second-step dissolution by using a lithium bromide solution to obtain a silk fibroin solution; dissolving insulin in hydrochloric acid, carrying out coaxial electric spraying with the silk fibroin solution mixed with glycerol, and freeze-drying to obtain insulin-loaded SF particles; and adding gelatin powder into the SF solution to prepare a silk fibroin-gelatin blend, and adding the insulin-loaded SF particles and tyrosinase to obtain the insulin-loaded composite hydrogel. The hydrogel prepared by the method has good controlled release performance, and can continuously release insulin to treat chronic wounds difficult to heal. The hydrogel has good biocompatibility and excellent mechanical properties, and insulin is utilized to treat wounds and promote wound healing.

column13: The invention belongs to the field of medical cosmetics, and relates to an acne-removing microneedle, in particular to a self-assembled gel acne-removing microneedle patch as well as a preparation method and application thereof. column12: Preparation and use method of injectable composite chitosan hydrogel for bone repair
column13: The invention relates to a preparation and use method of injectable composite chitosan hydrogel for bone repair. The hydrogel is mainly composed of modified chitosan, internally loaded cells and cell growth promoting factors. Firstly, a hydrogel precursor solution is prepared through emulsion polymerization, the main component of the hydrogel precursor solution is poly-N-isopropylacrylamide graft modified chitosan macromolecules, and the hydrogel can be in a solution state at the room temperature and achieve rapid gelation in the human physiological temperature environment. Through mixing with a cell suspension and the cell growth promoting factor, the obtained composite solution can realize in-situ rapid gelation at a bone tissue injury part and realize in-situ fixation of cells, so that not only can good support be provided for the injury part, but also adhesion, proliferation and differentiation of internal cells of the injury part can be promoted. The hydrogel is simple to prepare, convenient to use, quick in response and good in biocompatibility, so that the hydrogel can be applied to a plurality of biomedical related fields such as tissue repair, drug controlled release, cell culture and cancer treatment.

column12: Preparation method of artemisinin liposome loaded alginate-silk fibroin composite hydrogel

column12: Injectable hydrogel microsphere for treating orthopedic diseases as well as preparation method and application thereof
column13: The invention provides an injectable hydrogel microsphere for treating orthopedic diseases as well as a preparation method and application thereof. A hydrogel microsphere is taken as a matrix, a substance capable of enhancing the biological reaction activity is doped into the hydrogel microsphere, and a functionalized hydrogel microsphere is prepared by adopting a microfluidic technology and a photochemical cross-linking reaction. The orthopedic diseases include refractory bone healing or osteoarthritis. The substance capable of enhancing the biological reaction activity includes any one of fullerol nanocrystals, lipidosome loaded with KGN, and a copolymer obtained from dopamine methacrylamide and sulfobetaine methacrylate. The preparation method provided by the invention is simple, a prepared microgel material can effectively remove ROS, a good microenvironment is created for survival of mesenchymal stem cells, and osteogenic differentiation of the mesenchymal stem cells is promoted; and meanwhile, the drug loading stability can be improved, the controlled release of a drug is realized, and the effect of well treating and repairing the orthopedic diseases can be achieved.

column12: Self-healing temperature-sensitive hydrogel and preparation method thereof
column13: The invention relates to a self-healing temperature-sensitive hydrogel and a preparation method thereof. The hydrogel is prepared from hexanoylated ethylene glycol chitosan and 3, 4-dihydroxyphenyl propionic acid through an amidation reaction, and the molar ratio of the reactant 3, 4-dihydroxyphenyl propionic acid to amino on the hexanoylated ethylene glycol chitosan is 0.1:1-0.5:1. The method is mild in reaction condition, simple and safe to operate and easier to accept by researchers. The modified hexanoylated ethylene glycol chitosan hydrogel prepared by amidation reaction has self-healing property and temperature sensitivity. By controlling factors such as reaction time, molar ratio and solution concentration, sol-gel conversion temperature, self-healing time and efficiency of the hydrogel can be changed, and in addition, the hydrogel has low cytotoxicity and good biodegradability and has potential application value in the aspect of injectable drug sustained-release carriers.

column12: Preparation method of novel ocular drug delivery system
column13: The invention discloses a preparation method of a novel ocular drug delivery system. As hydrogel is taken as a carrier and biochar-zinc oxide having photoresponsiveness is uniformly dispersed in the hydrogel, the delivery system can have certain antibacterial and adjustable performance. The advantages of the delivery system are as follows: the delivery system can slowly release drugs; after the biochar-zinc oxide is added, the delivery system can have certain bacteriostasis and can adjust the releasing efficiency of the drugs through near infrared radiation, so that better treatment effects can be achieved.

column12: THREE-DIMENSIONAL CELL CULTURE PLATFORM AND USES THEREOF
column13: The present invention is directed to in vitro three-dimensional cell culture platforms for the growth of cells, including spheroids, tissues and organoids. The three-dimensional cell culture platforms of the present invention provide a surface interface formed by a cell supporting medium, which acts as a biological surface for cells to populate and grow. Specifically, the three-dimensional cell culture platforms comprise a cell supporting medium having at least one microwell formed therein, and one or more microwell spacers defining an entrance of the or each microwell, the entrance enabling the introduction of a cell culture medium into the or each microwell. Microfluidic devices comprising the cell culture platforms are also provided, together with methods for producing the cell culture platforms.

column12: Ocular drug delivery system and uses thereof
column13: Disclosed herein is an ocular drug delivery system, comprising a positively charged chitosan-modified hydrogel, a secretory phospholipase A2 (sPLA2) hydrolysable liposome encapsulating an anti-inflammatory drug and having a negative surface charge, a first thiolated hyaluronic acid (HA-SH) nanoparticle encapsulating a wound-healing drug and having a negative surface charge, and a second HA-SH nanoparticle encapsulating a transforming growth factor-β inhibitor and having a negative surface charge. The sPLA2 hydrolysable liposome and the first and second HA-SH nanoparticles are attached to the positively charged chitosan-modified hydrogel by electrostatic attraction. Uses of the system are also disclosed.

column12: Drug conjugated nanogels in microcapsule for delayed sustained protein delivery
column13: Injectable compositions and use of the injectable compositions in tissue engineering applications are described. The injectable compositions are hydrogel-based compositions that can be crosslinked in situ following placement. The injectable compositions include microcapsules having predetermined erosion profiles that are loaded with nanogels having predetermined sustained release profiles for signaling molecules conjugated to the nanogels. Following crosslinking, the compositions are designed to sequentially release signaling molecules over a predetermined period of time with various release profiles. The compositions can carry additional components to stimulate tissue generation such as stem cells and extracellular matrix (ECM) components.

column12: Palmitoyl peptide hydrogel as well as preparation method and application thereof
column13: The invention provides palmitoyl peptide hydrogel as well as a preparation method and application thereof. The palmitoyl peptide hydrogel comprises a three-dimensional reticular skeleton consisting ofpalmitoyl peptide and/or palmitoyl peptide derivatives, and water stuffed in gaps of the three-dimensional reticular skeleton, wherein the palmitoyl peptide hydrogel is acidic. The palmitoyl peptidehydrogel is formed by self-assembling the palmitoyl peptide and/or the palmitoyl peptide derivatives in an acidic environment under the driving of weak interactions such as hydrogen bond interaction,electrostatic interaction and hydrophobic interaction. The palmitoyl peptide hydrogel provided by the invention has the advantages of good biocompatibility, strong mechanical properties, resistance togastric acid environment, long gastric retention time and biodegradability, also has continuous and broad-spectrum bactericidal ability, and can be used for hygiene or preoperative disinfection of surgery or sustained release systems of oral drugs.

column12: Preparation method and application of photo-thermal driven drug release hydrogel microspheres
column13: The invention provides a preparation method and application of photo-thermal driven drug release hydrogel microspheres. The method is based on photonic crystal microspheres, and photonic crystal hydrogel hybrid microspheres with internal drug loading are prepared by means of microfluidic chip preparation, hydrogel filling and the like. The prepared photo-thermal driven drug release hydrogel microspheres can respond to irradiation of near-infrared light, controllably release carried active antibodies and cell growth factors, promote activation of T cells in vitro and realize in-vitro amplification of the T cells. The method is reasonable in design, simple to operate, low in preparation cost, capable of being widely applied to T cell in-vitro activation and amplification, high in practicability and suitable for popularization.

column13: The invention provides a hydrogel composition suitable for the controlled release of an active agent, such as a pharmaceutically active agent, which composition comprises (i) a hydrogel, and (ii) an oil-in-water emulsion entrapped in the hydrogel, wherein an active agent is incorporated into the oil droplets dispersed in the oil-in-water emulsion, and wherein the oil droplets comprise a hydrolyzable oil which undergoes hydrolysis with a first-order rate constant of hydrolysis between 180 hr- 1 and 0.18 hr-1 and which shows a solubility in water at a pH of 7.4 and a temperature of the water of 37°C in the range of 100 nM to 10 mM. As further aspects, processes for the production of these compositions are encompassed by the invention.

column12: Photodynamic Therapy Technique For Preventing Damage To The Fovea Of The Eye Or Another Body Portion Of A Patient
column13: A photodynamic therapy technique for preventing damage to the fovea of the eye or another body portion of a patient is disclosed herein. In one embodiment, a treatment laser is applied to a body portion of a patient using a painting technique, the treatment laser being configured to provide paint brush-type photodynamic therapy (PPDT) using the painting technique to the body portion of the patient by emitting light of a predetermined wavelength that is absorbed by tissue of the body portion of the patient to which a photosensitizer has been applied, the body portion of the patient being afflicted by a medical condition. The application of the treatment laser to the body portion of a patient using the painting technique treats the medical condition, reduces the symptoms associated with the medical condition, and/or alleviates the medical condition.

column12: WET-PACKED SOFT HYDROGEL OCULAR INSERTS
column13: The invention is generally related to a soft hydrogel ocular insert that is composed of at least one hydrogel material in fully hydrated state and can be comfortable for wearing. The hydrogel material comprises polymer chains, which are derived from at least one arylborono-containing hydrophilic copolymer and at least one mucoadhesive polymer, and cyclic boronic ester crosslinks for crosslinking those mucoadhesive polymer chains and arylborono-containing hydrophilic copolymer chains to form a 3-dimensional polymer network. Those cyclic boronic ester crosslinks can be hydrolyzed slowly in the tear of the eyes of a patient, resulting in the disintegration (dissolution) of the 3-dimensional polymer network and thereby providing mucoadhesisve polymers and optionally drugs impregnated in the hydrogel ocular insert in a controlled manner.

column12: Injectable and degradable heparin hydrogel and preparation method and application thereof
column13: The invention discloses injectable and degradable heparin hydrogel and a preparation method and application thereof. The preparation method includes the steps that adipic dihydrazide modified heparin(Hep-ADH) and aldehyde hyaluronic acid (HA-CHO) are dissolved in deionized water to prepare a solution with a certain concentration, and the Hep-ADH solution and the HA-CHO solution are extruded through a double-cylinder injector and then can be rapidly gelatinized in situ. The prepared gel can be extruded by a 25G injector, and can be completely degraded in PBS at 37 DEG C within several days. Byadjusting the solid contents and proportions of the two solutions, the gelling time of the hydrogel and the degradation speed of the hydrogel can be adjusted. The prepared heparin hydrogel can encapsulate drugs or cells, can simultaneously exert drug sustained release and heparin anti-coagulation functions after being injected into focus tissues in situ, can be used for preparing anti-coagulationmaterials with a drug sustained release function, and has potential application in the field of improvement of myocardial micro-circulation after myocardial infarction injury.

column12: Preparation method and application of biomineral composite hydrogel
column13: The invention provides a preparation method of biological mineral composite hydrogel. column12: OPIOID INDEPENDENT SURGICAL ANESTHETIC
column13: An opioid independent surgical anesthetic composition includes an injectable dosage form of a hydrogel that has a plurality of solid lipid matrix particles entrapped therein. The plurality of solid lipid matrix particles includes a lipophilic local anesthetic drug and a saturated triglyceride. Methods for creating a long-acting local anesthetic product can include creating a bulk solid of a lipid matrix product by heating a lipid solvent above its melting point, dissolving a lipophilic local anesthetic drug therein, and reducing a temperature of the resultant drug-lipid solution to below the melting point of the lipid solvent. The methods can further include crushing the bulk solid of the lipid matrix product to form solid lipid matrix particles and entrapping the solid lipid matrix particles within a hydrogel.

column12: Preparation and application of degradable, biocompatible and high-strength chitin hydrogel

The preparation method comprises the following steps: dropwise adding a cross-linking agent into a chitin solution with the concentration of 5-7% at -10 DEG C to 10 DEG C, conducting stirring for 1-2 hours, preparing gel by using a tape casting method, putting the gel into a coagulating bath with the temperature of -10 DEG C to 10 DEG C and the concentration of 80-100% for physical cross-linking for 6-8 hours, and finally conducting washing with water to obtain the chitin hydrogel. column12: Preparation method of self-repairing bionic hydrogel with toughness and adhesion
column13: The invention discloses a preparation method of a self-repairing bionic hydrogel with both toughness and adhesion. column12: CONTINUAL DRUG RELEASE DEVICE THAT CAN BE REPLENISHED WITH DRUGS
column13: Provided is a continual drug release device that can be implanted and can be replenished with drugs, the drug release device achieving drug delivery such that the drug release rate is controllable. This drug release device configured to be implanted in a living body allows drug replenishment in which drugs are supplied by the use of a syringe and a needle while the device remains implanted. The device has a capsule structure that includes: (i) a drug release section for releasing a drug to outside the device; (ii) a drug storage section for holding the drug; and (iii) a drug introduction section for introducing the drug to the drug storage section. The drug release section has a releasing surface having pores, and a hydrogel is kept in the drug release section. The drug storage section is adjacent to the drug release section. The drug held in the drug storage section passes through the drug release section and is released through the drug release section pores. Drugs are introduced into the drug storage section through the drug introduction section by the use of a syringe and a needle.

column12: Biocompatible hydrogel comprising hyaluronic acid and polyethylene glycol
column13: The present invention relates to a biocompatible hydrogel including hyaluronic acid and polyethylene glycol. Particularly, the present invention relates to a biocompatible hydrogel prepared by inducing intermolecular and/or intramolecular crosslinking of hyaluronic acid and polyethylene glycol merely by irradiating radiation without a reactor, addition of a chemical crosslinking agent, or the like, a method for preparing the same, and use of the biocompatible hydrogel. Since the hydrogel according to the present invention is prepared by inducing intermolecular and/or intramolecular crosslinking of hyaluronic acid and polyethylene glycol through electron beams, there is no concern about generation of in vivo toxicity caused by the incorporation of an organic solvent or crosslinking agent. In addition, the hydrogel according to the present invention requires no separate purification step during the preparation thereof and is amenable to mass production merely through electron beam irradiation for a short time, and thus shows excellent productivity. Further, since the hydrogel according to the present invention has excellent biocompatibility, it can be used advantageously for developing a cell carrier, drug carrier, adhesion-preventing agent, cell support, dental filler, orthopedic filler, wound patch, skin filler, or the like.

column12: Method of corneal transplantation or corneal inlay implantation with cross-linking
column13: A method of corneal implantation with cross-linking is disclosed herein. In one or more embodiments, the method includes the steps of: (i) forming a flap in a cornea of an eye so as to expose a stromal tissue of the cornea underlying the flap; (ii) pivoting the flap so as to expose the stromal tissue of the cornea underlying the flap; (iii) inserting an implant under the flap so as to overlie the stromal tissue of the cornea; (iv) applying laser energy and/or microwaves to the implant in the eye so as to modify the refractive power of the implant; (v) applying a cross-linking solution that includes a photosensitizer to the implant; (vi) covering the implant with the flap; and (vii) irradiating the implant so as to activate cross-linkers in the implant, and thereby cross-link the implant and the stromal tissue of the cornea surrounding the implant.

column12: Hydrogel material and drug delivery system
column13: The invention belongs to the technical field of pharmaceutical preparations, and particularly relates to a hydrogel material for drug delivery and a drug delivery system. The hydrogel material provided by the invention comprises hydroxypropyl methyl cellulose modified by a methacrylic acid group. The hydrogel material is a derivative obtained by modifying hydroxypropyl methyl cellulose with a methacrylic acid group, can drive physical entanglement to form a three-dimensional network structure in a water environment, realizes in-situ gelation, is not influenced by environmental temperature change in the gelation process, and is suitable for delivery of most drugs, so that the drug release duration is long. The drug delivery system provided by the invention comprises hydrogel for loading a drug, and the hydrogel is prepared from the hydrogel material or the hydrogel material prepared by the preparation method. The drug delivery system is high in drug encapsulation efficiency, long in drug sustained release time and suitable for various drugs.

column12: Preparation method of injectable composite hydrogel double-drug-loading system containing micelles
column13: The invention belongs to the field of drug carriers, and provides a preparation method of an injectable composite hydrogel double-drug-loading system containing micelles. Aiming at the requirements for the drug loading capacity, action time, treatment effect and the like, the double-drug-loading system firstly adopts a ring-opening polymerization method to synthesize the MPEG-P (CL-ran-TMC) polymer micelles, and a fat-soluble anti-cancer drug 1 is entrapped in the MPEGP polymer micelles; then, HA is oxidized by using sodium periodate to obtain AHA, and crosslinking is carried out on NOCC and the AHA to form NOCC/AHA hydrogel; and finally, the micelles entrapping the anti-cancer drug 1 and an anti-cancer drug 2 are entrapped into the NOCC/AHA hydrogel together, the double-drug-loaded hydrogel composite system anti-cancer drug 1/M+anti-cancer drug 2@gel is obtained, and the anti-cancer drug 1 and the anti-cancer drug 2 are different. By means of the composite hydrogel double-drug-loadingsystem, the bioavailability of fat-soluble anti-cancer drugs is improved, and the effects of local sustained-release drug delivery and combined treatment by using multiple anti-cancer drugs are achieved.

column13: The invention provides preparation, raw materials, a product and application of an optical coupling synergistic cross-linked hydrogel material. column12: Methods for producing chemoembolic agents for the delivery of anti-cancer agents
column13: Described herein are chemoembolic compositions and agents. The compositions include one or more anti-cancer agents and a silk-elastinlike protein polymer, wherein the compositions are liquids prior to administration to a subject but convert to hydrogels upon administration to the subject. Administration of the chemoembolic compositions to tumor and/or tumor vasculature in a subject having cancer can result in reduced or inhibited blood flow to the tumor as well as localized, sustained release of the anti-cancer agent in the vicinity of the tumor. Reduction in blood flow, in turn, results in a reduction of tumor volume and/or inhibition of tumor growth, while localized release of the anti-cancer agent results in reduced systemic effects and lower overall toxicity of treatment with the compositions.

column12: FRAMEWORK FOR IN-SILICO DESIGN AND TESTING OF VEHICLES AND FORMULATIONS FOR DELIVERY OF ACTIVE MOLECULES
column13: One of the key challenges in healthcare and personal care industries is arriving at an optimum delivery vehicle and formulation which can deliver a specified active molecule to an intended site of action with minimal or no side effects. This disclosure relates to method of designing and testing of a vehicle and formulation for delivery of an active molecule. A plurality of inputs is processed to generate plurality of drug delivery routes. The vehicle associated with formulation is designed based on plurality of parameters associated with the active molecule and the plurality of drug delivery routes. The designed vehicle associated with the formulation on an in-silico model of corresponding chosen drug delivery route is tested to obtain data associated with delivery of the active molecule. The data associated with delivery of the active molecule is reiteratively processed to obtain a desired data associated with the delivery of the active molecule.

column12: Preparation method of hydrogel drug carrier with light control characteristics
column13: The invention provides a preparation method of a hydrogel drug carrier with light control characteristics. The preparation method comprises the following steps: firstly, dissolving p-diaminoazobenzeneinto dimethylformamide, and adding triethylamine and acryloyl chloride to react to generate an azobenzene cross-linking agent; then mixing the prepared azobenzene cross-linking agent with a hydroxyethyl methacrylate monomer and N-vinyl pyrrolidone, and adding an initiator to form a composite hydrogel drug carrier; and finally, loading a drug into the hydrogel drug carrier in an adsorption manneror a copolymerization manner. According to the preparation method provided by the invention, the azobenzene cross-linking agent is introduced into hydrogel to realize control on a hydrogel mesh structure and improve the loading and controlled release capabilities of the hydrogel on the drug; the obtained hydrogel has a reversible response characteristic under the action of light and can be repeatedly used for multiple times; the performance of an obtained product meets basic requirements of the hydrogel drug carrier and release of the drug can be controlled; and the preparation method has relatively great social benefits and economic benefits.

column12: Drug-loaded sustained-release hydrogel as well as preparation method and application thereof
column13: The invention discloses drug-loaded sustained-release hydrogel as well as a preparation method and application thereof, and relates to the technical field of medical functional dressings. The drug-loaded sustained-release hydrogel includes drug-loaded microspheres and a hydrogel matrix. The preparation method includes the following steps: adding a drug into a sesbania gum solution as a water phase; adding Span-80 to vegetable oil as an oil phase, performing preheating, adding the water phase, and carrying out stirring; performing cooling, adding glutaraldehyde, and performing stirring; conducting dehydration flocculation, centrifugation, washing and freeze-drying to obtain the drug-loaded microspheres; and adding the drug-loaded microspheres to a chitosan derivative solution, adding an oxidized bamboo fiber solution after uniform dispersion, and carrying out stirring to obtain the drug-loaded sustained-release hydrogel. The prepared drug-loaded sustained-release hydrogel has better mechanical properties, antibacterial properties and swelling properties, the drug sustained-release effect is significantly improved, and the sudden release phenomenon of drug release is reduced; and thedrug-loaded sustained-release hydrogel does not cause secondary damage to wound tissue.

column12: CHITOSAN MATERIALS FROM CARBONIC ACID SOLUTION
column13: The present invention comprises chitosan materials and methods of using carbonic acid for aqueous solubilization of neutralized or pre-treated chitosan gels and provides, among other things, substantially acid salt free composition native final forms without requiring subsequent acid salt elution. The invention includes chitosan-based solid and semi-solid material forms, optionally reinforced with chitosan fibers, such as powders, fibers, films, matrices, sponges, implants, scaffolds, fillers, and hydrogels. Native final forms are produced from chitosan powder solubilized in an aqueous acidic solution, processed to form a high pH hydrated chitosan gel precipitate material that is then neutralized by water washing and re-solubilized substantially to chitosan solution using carbonic acid. Chitosan materials can be mixed in solution with one or more of other hydrophilic polymers to create compositional heterogeneity and pharmaceutical agents to achieve controlled release of the agent(s) from the final forms at the site of application.

column12: BOTTLEBRUSH COPOLYMERS AND USES THEREOF
column13: Materials (e.g., particles, hydrogels) that provide extended release of one or more therapeutic agents are useful platforms for drug delivery. In part, the present invention relates to new triblock (ABC) bottlebrush copolymers which can be used in the formulation of particles and hydrogels for the extended release of therapeutic agents. In certain embodiments, the triblock bottlebrush copolymers, particles, and hydrogels described herein are thermally-responsive and gel at physiological temperature (e.g., upon administration to a subject), providing injectable and/or implantable gels which can be used for extended release drug delivery. The present invention also provides methods for extended release drug delivery, and methods of treating and/or preventing a disease or conditions in a subject, using the inventive copolymers, particles, and hydrogels. In addition, the present invention provides methods of preparing the triblock bottlebrush copolymers described herein.

column12: PERFUSION ENABLED BIOREACTORS
column13: Disclosed herein is a bioreactor system that allows active perfusive flow through a porous support medium enabling 3D growth of biological samples. In some embodiments, the system comprises a sample well filled with a three-dimensional (3D) cell growth medium. The system can further comprise a liquid medium reservoir fluidly connected to the sample well by a first filter material. The system can further comprises a medium collection chamber fluidly connected to the sample well by a second filter material. In some embodiments, application of negative gage pressure to the medium collection chamber or positive pressure to the liquid medium reservoir draws fluid from the liquid medium reservoir, through the first filter material, into the sample well where it permeates the three-dimensional cell growth medium, through the second filter material, and finally into the medium collection chamber.

column13: The present invention relates to a liposomized insulin transdermal drug delivery patch composition for diabetes treatment, and a method for manufacturing a patch using the composition, wherein the liposomized insulin transdermal drug delivery patch composition continuously elutes insulin in which a hydrogel that corresponds to the skin temperature turns into a sol status when used by attaching to the skin, and penetrated into the skin by a transdermal drug delivery component, thereby lowering the blood sugar level to obtain an effect of treating diabetes. column12: Intelligent hydrogel formed from single protein
column13: The invention belongs to the field of biological materials, and particularly relates to intelligent hydrogel formed by single protein and having catalytic activity. The intelligent hydrogel is formedby diluting lipoic acid ligase protein (LplA) from escherichia coli into a buffer solution and controlling physical and chemical conditions of the system. The intelligent hydrogel has the advantages that the temperature sensitivity and reversibility are realized, the critical temperature range is 8-80 DEG C, hydrogel is formed when the critical temperature is higher than the critical temperature,the solution state is recovered when the temperature is reduced, the reversible conversion process can be repeated for more than 30 times, and meanwhile, the temperature response is sensitive, the conversion temperature range is within 2 DEG C, and the temperature response time is short (within 3 minutes). The hydrogel can also control the gel state by adjusting the pH and the ion concentration. The intelligent hydrogel can be widely applied to the fields of tissue engineering and medical cosmetology such as three-dimensional cell culture, drug sustained release, targeted therapy drug preparation, beauty skin care products and temperature sensing.

column12: Temperature-sensitive in-situ gel type nano slow-release eye drops and preparation method thereof
column13: The invention discloses temperature-sensitive in-situ gel type triamcinolone acetonide sustained-release eye drops and a preparation method thereof, and belongs to the field of pharmaceutical preparations. The preparation method comprises the following steps: modifying chitosan by using alginic acid to obtain modified chitosan; grafting collagen with the modified chitosan to obtain modified chitosan grafted collagen, and mixing the modified chitosan grafted collagen with water to obtain temperature-sensitive hydrogel; dissolving triamcinolone acetonide in vegetable oil to prepare an oil phase;adding an emulsifier into water to prepare a water phase; adding the oil phase into the water phase, and uniformly mixing to obtain a triamcinolone acetonide emulsion; and adding the triamcinolone acetonide emulsion, an osmotic pressure regulator, a bacteriostatic agent and an antioxidant into the temperature-sensitive hydrogel solution to prepare the temperature-sensitive in-situ gel type triamcinolone acetonide sustained-release eye drops. According to the invention, the encapsulation efficiency, drug loading capacity and slow release effect of triamcinolone acetonide in the eye drops are improved.

column13: FIELD: medicine; biotechnology; cosmetology.SUBSTANCE: invention refers to medicine, biotechnology, cosmetology and pharmaceutical industry, namely to production of therapeutic and preventive hydrogel material in form of sol-gel plate and methods for its production. column12: Self-assembled short-peptide hydrogel and application thereof
column13: The invention provides a self-assembled short-peptide hydrogel and application thereof, and belongs to the technical field of medical materials. The hydrogel at least comprises Ac-FFGK-NH2 short peptide and a chitosan caffeic acid derivative. The self-assembled short peptide hydrogel disclosed by the invention contains a large number of wrinkles, the surface area of the material is greatly increased by the wrinkles, a wide contact space is provided for the application of the hydrogel in the aspects of drug wrapping and the like, more drug molecules can be accommodated, and meanwhile, the sustained release of drugs is facilitated, so that the self-assembled short peptide hydrogel can be applied to drug delivery. Meanwhile, the self-assembled short peptide hydrogel disclosed by the inventioncan up-regulate expression of STAT3 and VEGF, is good in cell compatibility, is beneficial to cell proliferation, and promotes angiogenesis and granulation tissue regeneration at a wound. Therefore,the self-assembled short peptide hydrogel disclosed by the invention can be applied to preparation of materials for wound healing and/or injury repair.

column12: Albumin hydrogel as well as preparation method and application thereof
column13: The invention provides albumin hydrogel. The albumin hydrogel is prepared by mixing albumin, a cross-linking agent and a solvent, the cross-linking agent comprises a repeating unit having a structureof formula (I) and an end group having a structure of formula (II). Besides, as a good paclitaxel topical treatment drug carrier, the albumin hydrogel overcomes the defect of poor paclitaxel solubility, polyoxyethylene castor oil with biotoxicity is not introduced, and compared with a systemic preparation, the albumin hydrogel has the advantages that the administration frequency is effectively reduced, the drug concentration at a tumor is increased, and the systemic toxicity is reduced. Nanoparticles wrapping paclitaxel are used as gel forming components of the gel, so that uniform distribution of the paclitaxel in the gel can be realized, and stable and continuous release is realized.

column12: Photodynamic silicon dioxide nano material @ hydrogel composite drug delivery system as well as preparation method and application thereof
column13: The invention discloses a photodynamic silicon dioxide nano material @ hydrogel composite drug delivery system as well as a preparation method and application thereof. A silicon dioxide nano materialis used as an internal drug delivery material, and the size is 100-120 nm. Hydrogel is used as an external drug delivery material, and the network size is about 5 [mu]m. Hydrogel is formed in-vivo inan in-situ injection mode according to a Schiff base principle, and chemical bonds are destroyed under a weak acid condition and are slowly degraded. An anti-vascular drug CA4P carried by the hydrogelon the outer layer is released at first, and then DOX coated by the internal silicon dioxide nano material is released, so that drug combination is realized. In addition, the material also has an NIRexcited photodynamic therapy effect. In conclusion, the composite drug delivery system has the characteristics of inject-ability, degradability, sequential drug release and photodynamic therapy. Thegrowth of tumor tissues of solid tumors (such as breast cancer, liver cancer, cervical cancer, and the like) can be effectively inhibited through multiple modes of sequential release combined with photo-dynamics.

column12: Auris formulations for treating otic diseases and conditions
column13: Disclosed herein are compositions and methods for the treatment of otic disorders with immunomodulating agents and auris pressure modulators. In these methods, the auris compositions and formulations are administered locally to an individual afflicted with an otic disorder, through direct application of the immunomodulating and/or auris pressure modulating compositions and formulations onto the auris media and/or auris interna target areas, or via perfusion into the auris media and/or auris interna structures.

column12: PHOTO-CROSSLINKED HYDROGEL MATERIAL AND PREPARATION, COMPOSITION, AND APPLICATION THEREOF PHOTO-CROSSLINKED HYDROGEL
column13: This invention provides preparations, compositions, products, and applications of photo-crosslinked hydrogels. Component A—a photosensitive polymer derivative, component B—the photoinitiator, and auxiliary component C—other biocompatible polymer derivative each are respectively dissolved in a biocompatible medium to obtain solution A, solution B, and solution C. The solution A, the solution B, and the optional solution C are mixed homogenously to obtain a hydrogel precursor solution. The hydrogel precursor solution is subject to irradiation of the UV light for photocoupled crosslinking to form a photo-crosslinked hydrogel. The photo-crosslinked hydrogel exhibit rapid speed of photo-curing, strong tissue adhesion, excellent mechanical properties, good biocompatibility, and excellent clinical operability. In addition, this invention also provides a kit for making the photo-crosslinked hydrogel, and applications thereof in tissue engineering, regenerative medicine, 3D printing, and as a carrier of cell, protein, or drug.

column12: PHOTO-COUPLED SYNERGISTICALLY CROSSLINKED HYDROGEL MATERIAL AND ITS COMPOSITION, PREPARATION METHOD, USE, PRODUCT, AND PREPARATION KIT
column13: This invention provides a preparation, composition, product, and application of a photo-coupled synergistically crosslinked hydrogel material. The preparation includes dissolving Component A including a photosensitive polymer derivative having o-nitrobenzyl phototriggers and Component B including a polymer derivative having amine or alkene (double group) or sulfhydryl group in a biocompatible medium to obtain solution A and solution B, respectively; mixing the solution A and solution B homogeneously to obtain a hydrogel precursor solution; initiating photo-coupled synergistic crosslinking under an irradiation of a UV light to form the hydrogel. The irradiation causes the o-nitrobenzyl phototriggers to generate an aldehyde group/keto group or a nitroso group to initiate photo-coupled synergetic crosslinking. The photo-coupled synergistically crosslinked hydrogel has applications in tissue engineering, regenerative medicine, 3D printing and as a carrier of cell, protein or drug.

column13: Described are methods and devices for the generation of hydrogel particles with micrometer and submicrometer dimensions using oxygen-inhibited partial polymerization, and the particles generated therefrom. column12: Nanoparticles in thermoreversible gels for enhanced therapeutics
column13: The present invention provides a sustained drug delivery system for the treatment of age-related macular degeneration (AMD), comprising corticosteroid encapsulated nanoparticles incorporated into a thermoreversible hydrogel. The corticosteroid may be triamcinolone acetate (TA), dexamethasone, or loteprednol etabonate (LE). The proposed drug delivery system is nontoxic to ARPE-19 (retinal pigment epithelium) cells and significantly reduces VEGF (vascular endothelial growth factor) expression as compared to solutions of the coticosteroids. The present invention provides sustained delivery of the corticosteroid to the posterior segment of the eye, reducing the frequency of intraocular injections necessary to maintain therapeutic concentrations.

column12: Bone fusion hydrogel scaffold and preparation method thereof
column13: The invention discloses a bone fusion hydrogel scaffold and a preparation method thereof. The bone fusion hydrogel scaffold is subjected to 3D printing under ultraviolet excitation to form a cell scaffold with a three-dimensional structure; the bone fusion hydrogel scaffold comprises a drug loading layer, a first osteogenesis mediation layer and a second osteogenesis mediation layer which are subjected to 3D printing to form a reticular disc structure; the drug loading layer, the first osteogenesis mediation layer and the second osteogenesis mediation layer are sequentially adhered and cured from top to bottom through polymer hydrogel to form the multilayer and porous hydrogel scaffold; the drug loading layer is prepared from the polymer hydrogel and rhBMP-2-loaded 2-N, 6-O-sulfated chitosan (rhBMP-2/NPs); and the first osteogenesis mediation layer and the second osteogenesis mediation layer are prepared from the polymer hydrogel and hydroxyapatite nanocrystals (nHA). The prepared bonefusion hydrogel scaffold can ensure that a bone fusion material has the high mechanical strength, the high porosity and the high precision, and also has the capability of promoting bone marrow mesenchymal stem cell and bone tissue ingrowth by microsphere controlled release of bone growth factors so as to induce bone repair.

column12: Preparation method of brinzolamide imprinted hydrogel contact lens for sustained and controlled release administration
column13: The invention discloses a preparation method of a molecularly imprinted hydrogel contact lens for sustained and controlled release administration. The method comprises the following steps: mixing choline chloride and methacrylic acid according to a certain proportion, and preparing a hydrophilic functional monomer deep eutectic solvent (DES) in an oil bath at 90 DEG C; taking brinzolamide as a template, hydroxyethyl methacrylate as a framework monomer, DES as a functional monomer, and polyethylene glycol dimethacrylate as a crosslinking agent to perform ultrasonic treatment under action of aninitiator AIBN to obtain a pre-polymerization solution; removing oxygen from the pre-polymerization solution, performing balancing in the dark, then injecting the pre-polymerization solution into a mold, performing ultraviolet polymerization, performing cutting by a round punch, performing eluting to remove unreacted substances, and performing drying to obtain the hydrogel contact lens. The hydrogel contact lens prepared by the preparation method has large drug loading amount, can realize slow release of drugs, and has the advantages of greatly improved bioavailability, good permeability, longretention time, better convenience and higher efficiency compared with a traditional ophthalmic preparation.

column12: SELF-GELLING SOLUTIONS FOR ADMINISTRATION OF THERAPEUTICS TO THE INNER EAR

column12: Rosin-based small molecular weight hydrogelator and its application
column13: The present disclosure discloses a rosin-based small molecular weight hydrogelator and an application thereof, and belongs to the fields of supramolecular chemistry, surfactant science and chemical utilization of rosin. The rosin-based small molecular hydrogel of the present disclosure can gel water at a very low concentration, and the critical gelling concentration is only 0.176 wt %. On average, each gelling agent molecule can hold 13,889 water molecules, which exhibits extremely high gel efficiency and the formed small molecular hydrogel also exhibits extremely high stability. This small molecule hydrogel is derived from the natural product rosin and has a mild nature. It can be used in the fields of drug sustained-release, tissue engineering, daily chemicals, medicine and so on. At the same time, the rosin-based small molecular hydrogel 6-dehydroabietylamide amine oxide in the present disclosure can form a stable gel emulsion for most oils, and can be used in many fields such as food, medicine, daily chemicals, tissue engineering, environmental protection, and water pollution control.

column12: Preparation method of drug-loaded microspheres with tumor microenvironment responsiveness
column13: The invention discloses a preparation method of drug-loaded microspheres with tumor microenvironment responsiveness.
